【注】此题也可凑微分.

$\begin{array}{r l} \int \frac {x ^ {3}}{\sqrt {1 + x ^ {2}}} \mathrm{d} x & = \int \frac {x ^ {2} \cdot \mathrm{d} (1 + x ^ {2})}{2 \sqrt {1 + x ^ {2}}} = \int (x ^ {2} + 1 - 1) \mathrm{d} (\sqrt {1 + x ^ {2}}) \\ & = \int (\sqrt {x ^ {2} + 1}) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} (\sqrt {1 + x ^ {2}}) - \int \mathrm{d} (\sqrt {1 + x ^ {2}}) \\ & = \frac {1}{3} (1 + x ^ {2}) ^ {\frac {3}{2}} - (1 + x ^ {2}) ^ {\frac {1}{2}} + C. \end{array}$

(Ⅳ) 令 $\tan t = x$ ，则 $\mathrm{d}x = \sec^2 t\mathrm{d}t$ ，故

$\begin{array}{r l} \int \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{(2 x ^ {2} + 1) \sqrt {1 + x ^ {2}}} & = \int \frac {\mathrm{d} t}{(2 \tan^ {2} t + 1) \cos t} \\ & = \int \frac {\cos t \mathrm{d} t}{2 \sin^ {2} t + \cos^ {2} t} = \int \frac {\mathrm{d} (\sin t)}{1 + \sin^ {2} t} = \arctan (\sin t) + C. \end{array}$

又 $\sin t = \frac{x}{\sqrt{1 + x^2}}$ ，故 $I = \arctan \frac{x}{\sqrt{1 + x^2}} + C.$

(V)

$\begin{array}{r l} \int \frac {\arctan \sqrt {x - 1}}{x \sqrt {x - 1}} \mathrm{d} x & = 2 \int \frac {\arctan \sqrt {x - 1}}{x} \mathrm{d} (\sqrt {x - 1}) \\ & = 2 \int \frac {\arctan \sqrt {x - 1}}{1 + (\sqrt {x - 1}) ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} (\sqrt {x - 1}) \\ & = 2 \int \arctan \sqrt {x - 1} \mathrm{d} (\arctan \sqrt {x - 1}) \\ & = (\arctan \sqrt {x - 1}) ^ {2} + C. \end{array}$

(VI)

$\begin{array}{r l} \int \sqrt {\frac {x}{1 - x \sqrt {x}}} \mathrm{d} x & = \int \frac {\sqrt {x}}{\sqrt {1 - x \sqrt {x}}} \mathrm{d} x = \frac {2}{3} \int \frac {\mathrm{d} (x ^ {\frac {3}{2}})}{\sqrt {1 - x ^ {\frac {3}{2}}}} = - \frac {2}{3} \int \frac {\mathrm{d} (1 - x ^ {\frac {3}{2}})}{\sqrt {1 - x ^ {\frac {3}{2}}}} \\ & = - \frac {2}{3} \cdot 2 \int \mathrm{d} \left(\sqrt {1 - x ^ {\frac {3}{2}}}\right) = - \frac {4}{3} \sqrt {1 - x \sqrt {x}} + C. \end{array}$

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容:
求下列积分:
$$(I) \int\frac{dx}{\sin^{2}x\cos^{4}x};$$
$$(II) \int\frac{dx}{1+\sin x};$$
$$(III) \int\frac{\sin x}{\sin x+\cos x}dx;$$
$$(IV) \int \frac{3\sin x + \cos x}{\sin x + 2\cos x}\mathrm{d}x;$$
$$(V) \int\frac{dx}{\sin2x+2\sin x};$$
$$(VI) \int \frac{\mathrm{d}x}{a^2\sin^2x + b^2\cos^2x}\left(a^2 +b^2 >0\right).$$
解析:
$\begin{array}{r l} \text { 解 (I) } & \int \frac {1}{\sin^ {2} x \cos^ {4} x} \mathrm{d} x = \int \frac {(\sin^ {2} x + \cos^ {2} x) ^ {2}}{\sin^ {2} x \cos^ {4} x} \mathrm{d} x = \int \left(\frac {\sin^ {2} x}{\cos^ {4} x} + \frac {2}{\cos^ {2} x} + \frac {1}{\sin^ {2} x}\right) \mathrm{d} x \\ & = \int \tan^ {2} x \mathrm{d} (\tan x) + 2 \tan x - \cot x = \frac {1}{3} \tan^ {3} x + 2 \tan x - \cot x + C. \end{array} 3$

【注】求解三角有理式积分,首先考虑利用恒等变形、三角公式,一般的方法是利用万能代换.此题也可以分子分母同时乘以 $\cos^{2}x$ , 得

$\begin{array}{r l} \int \frac {1}{\sin^ {2} x \cos^ {4} x} \mathrm{d} x & = \int \frac {1}{\tan^ {2} x \cos^ {6} x} \mathrm{d} x = \int \frac {\sec^ {4} x}{\tan^ {2} x} \mathrm{d} (\tan x) \\ & = \int \frac {\tan^ {4} x + 2 \tan^ {2} x + 1}{\tan^ {2} x} \mathrm{d} (\tan x) = \frac {1}{3} \tan^ {3} x + 2 \tan x - \cot x + C. \end{array}$

（Ⅱ）分子分母同时乘以 $(1-\sin x)$ ，再凑微分，得

$\int \frac {1}{1 + \sin x} \mathrm{d} x = \int \frac {1 - \sin x}{\cos^ {2} x} \mathrm{d} x = \int \frac {1}{\cos^ {2} x} \mathrm{d} x + \int \frac {1}{\cos^ {2} x} \mathrm{d} (\cos x) = \tan x - \frac {1}{\cos x} + C.$

【注】也可利用三角公式,即

$\begin{array}{r l} \int \frac {1}{1 + \sin x} \mathrm{d} x & = \int \frac {1}{1 + 2 \sin \frac {x}{2} \cos \frac {x}{2}} \mathrm{d} x = \int \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{\left(\sin \frac {x}{2} + \cos \frac {x}{2}\right) ^ {2}} \\ & = \int \frac {\sec^ {2} \frac {x}{2}}{\left(1 + \tan \frac {x}{2}\right) ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x = 2 \int \frac {\mathrm{d} \left(\tan \frac {x}{2}\right)}{\left(1 + \tan \frac {x}{2}\right) ^ {2}} = - \frac {2}{1 + \tan \frac {x}{2}} + C. \end{array}$

$\begin{array}{r l} \int \frac {\sin x}{\sin x + \cos x} \mathrm{d} x & = \frac {1}{2} \int \frac {(\sin x + \cos x) + (\sin x - \cos x)}{\sin x + \cos x} \mathrm{d} x \\ & = \frac {1}{2} \int \mathrm{d} x - \frac {1}{2} \int \frac {\mathrm{d} (\sin x + \cos x)}{\sin x + \cos x} = \frac {1}{2} x - \frac {1}{2} \ln | \sin x + \cos x | + C. \end{array} Ⅲ$

【注】 这里利用了

$f (x) = \frac {f (x) + f (- x)}{2} + \frac {f (x) - f (- x)}{2},$

即 $f(x)$ 可以表示成一个偶函数与一个奇函数之和.

(Ⅳ) 考虑拆项凑微分. 令

$3 \sin x + \cos x = A (\sin x + 2 \cos x) + B (\cos x - 2 \sin x),$

比较两边系数,可得 A = 1, B = -1, 故

$\begin{array}{r l} \int \frac {3 \sin x + \cos x}{\sin x + 2 \cos x} \mathrm{d} x & = \int \frac {(\sin x + 2 \cos x) - (\cos x - 2 \sin x)}{\sin x + 2 \cos x} \mathrm{d} x \\ & = \int \mathrm{d} x - \int \frac {\mathrm{d} (\sin x + 2 \cos x)}{\sin x + 2 \cos x} = x - \ln | \sin x + 2 \cos x | + C. \end{array}$

（V）利用万能代换. 令 $\tan \frac{x}{2} = t$ ，则 $\sin x = \frac{2t}{1 + t^2}$ ， $\cos x = \frac{1 - t^2}{1 + t^2}$ ， $\mathrm{d}x = \frac{2\mathrm{d}t}{1 + t^2}$ ，故

$\begin{array}{r l} \int \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{\sin 2 x + 2 \sin x} & = \int \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{2 \sin x \cos x + 2 \sin x} = \int \frac {\frac {2 \mathrm{d} x}{1 + t ^ {2}}}{2 \cdot \frac {2 t}{1 + t ^ {2}} \cdot \frac {1 - t ^ {2}}{1 + t ^ {2}} + 2 \cdot \frac {2 t}{1 + t ^ {2}}} \\ & = \frac {1}{4} \int \frac {1 + t ^ {2}}{t} \mathrm{d} t = \frac {1}{4} \int \frac {1}{t} \mathrm{d} t + \frac {1}{4} \int t \mathrm{d} t = \frac {1}{4} \ln | t | + \frac {1}{8} t ^ {2} + C \\ & = \frac {1}{4} \ln \left| \tan \frac {x}{2} \right| + \frac {1}{8} \tan^ {2} \frac {x}{2} + C. \end{array}$

(VI) 当 $a = 0, b \neq 0$ 时， $\int \frac{\mathrm{d}x}{a^2 \sin^2 x + b^2 \cos^2 x} = \int \frac{\mathrm{d}x}{b^2 \cos^2 x} = \frac{1}{b^2} \tan x + C;$

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容:
求下列积分:
$$(I) \int\arctan\sqrt{x}dx;$$
$$(II)\int \frac{\ln x}{(1 - x)^{2}}\mathrm{d}x;$$
$$(III) \int\frac{x^{2}e^{x}}{(x+2)^{2}}dx;$$
$$(IV)\int \sin (\ln x)\mathrm{d}x;$$
$$(V)\int \frac{1}{x^2}\sqrt{\frac{1 - x}{1 + x}}\mathrm{d}x;$$
$$(VI)\int \mathrm{e}^{2x}(1 + \tan x)^{2}\mathrm{d}x.$$
解析:
解（I）用分部积分法.

$\begin{array}{r l} \int \arctan \sqrt {x} \mathrm{d} x & = x \arctan \sqrt {x} - \int x \cdot \frac {1}{1 + x} \cdot \frac {1}{2 \sqrt {x}} \mathrm{d} x \\ & = x \arctan \sqrt {x} - \frac {1}{2} \int \frac {x + 1 - 1}{\sqrt {x} (1 + x)} \mathrm{d} x \\ & = x \arctan \sqrt {x} - \int \frac {1}{2 \sqrt {x}} \mathrm{d} x + \int \frac {\mathrm{d} (\sqrt {x})}{1 + (\sqrt {x}) ^ {2}} \\ & = x \arctan \sqrt {x} - \sqrt {x} + \arctan \sqrt {x} + C. \end{array}$

(Ⅱ)

$\begin{array}{r l} \int \frac {\ln x}{(1 - x) ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x & = - \int \ln x \mathrm{d} \left(\frac {1}{x - 1}\right) = - \frac {\ln x}{x - 1} + \int \frac {1}{x - 1} \cdot \frac {1}{x} \mathrm{d} x \\ & = - \frac {\ln x}{x - 1} + \int \left(\frac {1}{x - 1} - \frac {1}{x}\right) \mathrm{d} x = - \frac {\ln x}{x - 1} + \ln | x - 1 | - \ln x + C. \end{array}$

(Ⅲ)

$\begin{array}{r l} \int \frac {x ^ {2} \mathrm{e} ^ {x}}{(x + 2) ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x & = - \int x ^ {2} \mathrm{e} ^ {x} \mathrm{d} \left(\frac {1}{x + 2}\right) = - x ^ {2} \mathrm{e} ^ {x} \cdot \frac {1}{x + 2} + \int \frac {1}{x + 2} \mathrm{d} (x ^ {2} \mathrm{e} ^ {x}) \\ & = - \frac {x ^ {2} \mathrm{e} ^ {x}}{x + 2} + \int \frac {x ^ {2} \mathrm{e} ^ {x} + 2 x \mathrm{e} ^ {x}}{x + 2} \mathrm{d} x = - \frac {x ^ {2} \mathrm{e} ^ {x}}{x + 2} + \int x \mathrm{e} ^ {x} \mathrm{d} x \\ & = - \frac {x ^ {2} \mathrm{e} ^ {x}}{x + 2} + x \mathrm{e} ^ {x} - \int \mathrm{e} ^ {x} \mathrm{d} x = - \frac {x ^ {2} \mathrm{e} ^ {x}}{x + 2} + x \mathrm{e} ^ {x} - \mathrm{e} ^ {x} + C. \end{array}$

(Ⅳ) 令 $\ln x = t$ ，则 $x = e^{t}$ ， $dx = e^{t}dt$ .

$\begin{array}{r l} \int \sin (\ln x) \mathrm{d} x & = \int \sin t \cdot \mathrm{e} ^ {t} \mathrm{d} t = \int \sin t \mathrm{d} (\mathrm{e} ^ {t}) = \mathrm{e} ^ {t} \sin t - \int \mathrm{e} ^ {t} \cos t \mathrm{d} t \\ & = \mathrm{e} ^ {t} \sin t - \int \cos t \mathrm{d} (\mathrm{e} ^ {t}) = \mathrm{e} ^ {t} \sin t - \left(\mathrm{e} ^ {t} \cos t + \int \mathrm{e} ^ {t} \sin t \mathrm{d} t\right), \end{array}$

设 $I = \int \mathrm{e}^{t}\sin t\mathrm{d}t$ ，则 $I = \mathrm{e}^t\sin t - \mathrm{e}^t\cos t - I$ ，即

$I = \frac {1}{2} (\mathrm{e} ^ {t} \sin t - \mathrm{e} ^ {t} \cos t) + C = \frac {1}{2} x [ \sin (\ln x) - \cos (\ln x) ] + C.$

(V) 令 $\sqrt{\frac{1 - x}{1 + x}} = t$ ，则 $x = \frac{1 - t^2}{1 + t^2}, \mathrm{d}x = -\frac{4t}{(1 + t^2)^2} \mathrm{d}t$ ，故

$\begin{array}{r l} \int \frac {1}{x ^ {2}} \sqrt {\frac {1 - x}{1 + x}} \mathrm{d} x & = - \int \frac {4 t ^ {2}}{(1 - t ^ {2}) ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} t \\ & = - 2 \int \frac {t \mathrm{d} (t ^ {2})}{(1 - t ^ {2}) ^ {2}} = - 2 \int t \mathrm{d} \left(\frac {1}{1 - t ^ {2}}\right) \\ & = - \frac {2 t}{1 - t ^ {2}} + 2 \int \frac {1}{1 - t ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} t = - \frac {2 t}{1 - t ^ {2}} + \ln \left| \frac {1 + t}{1 - t} \right| + C \\ & = - \frac {\sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}}}{x} + \ln \left| \frac {\sqrt {1 + x} + \sqrt {1 - x}}{\sqrt {1 + x} - \sqrt {1 - x}} \right| + C. \end{array}$

【注】此题也可利用倒代换. 令 $x = \frac{1}{t}$ , 则 $\mathrm{dx} = -\frac{1}{t^2}\mathrm{dt}$ , 故

$\int \frac {1}{x ^ {2}} \sqrt {\frac {1 - x}{1 + x}} \mathrm{d} x = - \int \sqrt {\frac {t - 1}{t + 1}} \mathrm{d} t,$

再令 $\sqrt{\frac{t - 1}{t + 1}} = u$ ，去根号继续求解即可.

(VI)

$\begin{array}{r l} \int \mathrm{e} ^ {2 x} (1 + \tan x) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x & = \int \mathrm{e} ^ {2 x} (1 + 2 \tan x + \tan^ {2} x) \mathrm{d} x \\ & = \int \mathrm{e} ^ {2 x} \sec^ {2} x \mathrm{d} x + 2 \int \mathrm{e} ^ {2 x} \tan x \mathrm{d} x \\ & = \int \mathrm{e} ^ {2 x} \mathrm{d} (\tan x) + 2 \int \mathrm{e} ^ {2 x} \tan x \mathrm{d} x \\ & = \mathrm{e} ^ {2 x} \tan x - 2 \int \mathrm{e} ^ {2 x} \tan x \mathrm{d} x + 2 \int \mathrm{e} ^ {2 x} \tan x \mathrm{d} x \\ & = \mathrm{e} ^ {2 x} \tan x + C. \end{array}$

【注】此题通过分部积分法消去 $2\int e^{2x}\tan x dx$ ，这类问题一般也可凑微分.

$\begin{array}{r l} \int \mathrm{e} ^ {2 x} \sec^ {2} x \mathrm{d} x + 2 \int \mathrm{e} ^ {2 x} \tan x \mathrm{d} x & = \int (\mathrm{e} ^ {2 x} \sec^ {2} x + 2 \mathrm{e} ^ {2 x} \tan x) \mathrm{d} x \\ & = \int \mathrm{d} (\mathrm{e} ^ {2 x} \tan x) = \mathrm{e} ^ {2 x} \tan x + C. \end{array}$

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容:
求下列积分:
$$(I) \int_{-\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\left(x^{2}\ln\frac{1+x}{1-x}-\cos x\right)\mathrm{d}x;$$
$$(II)\int_{-1}^{1}(2 + \sin x)\sqrt{1 - x^2}\mathrm{d}x;$$
$$(III)\int_{-2}^{2}(x+|x|)\mathrm{e}^{-|x|}\mathrm{d}x;$$
$$(IV)\int_{-1}^{1}\frac{2x^{2} + x(\mathrm{e}^{x} + \mathrm{e}^{-x})}{1 + \sqrt{1 - x^{2}}}\mathrm{d}x.$$
解析:
解 在对称区间上积分, 考察被积函数的奇偶性.

(I) $\ln \frac{1 + x}{1 - x} = \ln (1 + x) - \ln (1 - x)$ 是奇函数， $\cos x$ 是偶函数，故

$\int_ {- \frac {\pi}{4}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{4}} \left(x ^ {2} \ln \frac {1 + x}{1 - x} - \cos x\right) \mathrm{d} x = 0 - 2 \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{4}} \cos x \mathrm{d} x = - \sqrt {2}.Ⅱ$

$\int_ {- 1} ^ {1} (2 + \sin x) \sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x = 4 \int_ {0} ^ {1} \sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x + 0 = 4 \cdot \frac {1}{4} \pi = \pi .$

(Ⅲ)

$\begin{array}{r l} \int_ {- 2} ^ {2} (x + | x |) e ^ {- | x |} d x & = 0 + 2 \int_ {0} ^ {2} | x | e ^ {- | x |} d x = 2 \int_ {0} ^ {2} x e ^ {- x} d x \\ & = - 2 x e ^ {- x} \Big | _ {0} ^ {2} + 2 \int_ {0} ^ {2} e ^ {- x} d x = 2 - 6 e ^ {- 2}. \end{array}$

（IV）因 $\frac{2x^2}{1 + \sqrt{1 - x^2}}$ 是偶函数， $\frac{x(\mathrm{e}^x + \mathrm{e}^{-x})}{1 + \sqrt{1 - x^2}}$ 是奇函数，故

$\int_ {- 1} ^ {1} \frac {2 x ^ {2} + x (\mathrm{e} ^ {x} + \mathrm{e} ^ {- x})}{1 + \sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}}} \mathrm{d} x = 4 \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {x ^ {2}}{1 + \sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}}} \mathrm{d} x + 0 = 4 \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm{d} x - 4 \int_ {0} ^ {1} \sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x = 4 - \pi .$

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容:
求下列积分:
$$(I) \int_{0}^{2}(x-1)^{2}\sqrt{2x-x^{2}}\mathrm{d}x;$$
$$(II)\int_{0}^{\pi}(\mathrm{e}^{-\cos x}-\mathrm{e}^{\cos x})\mathrm{d}x.$$
解析:
解 (I)

$\begin{array}{r l} \int_ {0} ^ {2} (x - 1) ^ {2} \sqrt {2 x - x ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x & = \int_ {0} ^ {2} (x - 1) ^ {2} \sqrt {1 - (x - 1) ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x \\ & \frac {x - 1 = t}{- 1} \int_ {- 1} ^ {1} t ^ {2} \sqrt {1 - t ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} t = 2 \int_ {0} ^ {1} t ^ {2} \sqrt {1 - t ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} t \\ & \frac {t = \sin u}{- 1} 2 \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \cos^ {2} u \sin^ {2} u \mathrm{d} u = 2 \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} (1 - \sin^ {2} u) \sin^ {2} u \mathrm{d} u \\ & = 2 \times \frac {1}{2} \times \frac {\pi}{2} - 2 \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sin^ {4} u \mathrm{d} u = \frac {\pi}{8}. \end{array}$

(Ⅱ)

$\int_ {0} ^ {\pi} (\mathrm{e} ^ {- \cos x} - \mathrm{e} ^ {\cos x}) \mathrm{d} x \xlongequal {x = \frac {\pi}{2} + t} \int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} (\mathrm{e} ^ {\sin t} - \mathrm{e} ^ {- \sin t}) \mathrm{d} t = 0.$

【注】 $e^{\sin t}-e^{-\sin t}$ 是奇函数.

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容:
求下列积分:
$$(I) \int_{-3}^{2}\min\{2,x^{2}\}dx;$$
$$(II)\int_{-1}^{x}(1 - |t|)dt(x \geqslant -1);$$
$$(III)\int_{-1}^{1}|x-y|e^{x}dx(|y|\leqslant1);$$
$$(IV)\int_{0}^{\pi}\sqrt{1 - \sin x}\mathrm{d}x.$$
解析:
解（I）因为 $\min\{2, x^{2}\} = \begin{cases} 2, & -3 \leqslant x \leqslant -\sqrt{2}, \\ x^{2}, & -\sqrt{2} < x < \sqrt{2}, \\ 2, & \sqrt{2} \leqslant x \leqslant 2, \end{cases}$ ，故

$\begin{array}{r l} \int_ {- 3} ^ {2} \min \{2, x ^ {2} \} \mathrm{d} x & = \int_ {- 3} ^ {- \sqrt {2}} \min \{2, x ^ {2} \} \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {- \sqrt {2}} ^ {\sqrt {2}} \min \{2, x ^ {2} \} \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {\sqrt {2}} ^ {2} \min \{2, x ^ {2} \} \mathrm{d} x \\ & = \int_ {- 3} ^ {- \sqrt {2}} 2 \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {- \sqrt {2}} ^ {\sqrt {2}} x ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {\sqrt {2}} ^ {2} 2 \mathrm{d} x = 1 0 - \frac {8}{3} \sqrt {2}. \end{array}$

（Ⅱ）当 $-1 \leqslant x < 0$ 时， $\int_{-1}^{x} (1 - |t|) \mathrm{d}t = \int_{-1}^{x} (1 + t) \mathrm{d}t = \frac{(1 + t)^2}{2} \Bigg|_{-1}^x = \frac{(1 + x)^2}{2}$ ;

当 $x \geqslant 0$ 时， $\int_{-1}^{x} (1 - |t|) \, \mathrm{d}t = \int_{-1}^{0} (1 + t) \, \mathrm{d}t + \int_{0}^{x} (1 - t) \, \mathrm{d}t = 1 - \frac{1}{2} (1 - x)^2.$

【注】注意当 $x \geqslant 0$ 时， $\int_{-1}^{x} (1 - |t|) \mathrm{d}t \neq \int_{-1}^{x} (1 - t) \mathrm{d}t.$

（Ⅲ）分段积分，去绝对值符号.

$\begin{array}{r l} \int_ {- 1} ^ {1} | x - y | \mathrm{e} ^ {x} \mathrm{d} x & = \int_ {- 1} ^ {y} (y - x) \mathrm{e} ^ {x} \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {y} ^ {1} (x - y) \mathrm{e} ^ {x} \mathrm{d} x \\ & = (y - x) \mathrm{e} ^ {x} \Big | _ {- 1} ^ {y} + \int_ {- 1} ^ {y} \mathrm{e} ^ {x} \mathrm{d} x + (x - y) \mathrm{e} ^ {x} \Big | _ {y} ^ {1} - \int_ {y} ^ {1} \mathrm{e} ^ {x} \mathrm{d} x \\ & = 2 \mathrm{e} ^ {y} - (y + 2) \mathrm{e} ^ {- 1} - y \mathrm{e}. \end{array}$

$\begin{array}{r l} \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \sqrt {1 - \sin x} \mathrm{d} x & = \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \left| \sin \frac {x}{2} - \cos \frac {x}{2} \right| \mathrm{d} x \\ & = \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \left(\cos \frac {x}{2} - \sin \frac {x}{2}\right) \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {\frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\pi} \left(\sin \frac {x}{2} - \cos \frac {x}{2}\right) \mathrm{d} x = 4 (\sqrt {2} - 1). \end{array}$
（IV）
【注】因为 $\sqrt{1-\sin x}$ 在 $[0,\pi]$ 上关于直线 $x=\frac{\pi}{2}$ 对称, 所以

$\begin{array}{r l} \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \sqrt {1 - \sin x} \mathrm{d} x & = 2 \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sqrt {1 - \sin x} \mathrm{d} x \\ & = 2 \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \left(\cos \frac {x}{2} - \sin \frac {x}{2}\right) \mathrm{d} x \\ & = 4 (\sqrt {2} - 1). \end{array}$

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容:
求下列积分:
$$(I) \int_{-\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}(x+\sin^{2}x)\cos^{2}x\,dx;$$
$$(II)\int_{0}^{1}x(1 - x^{4})^{\frac{3}{2}}\mathrm{d}x;$$
$$(III)\int_{0}^{\pi}t\sin tdt;$$
$$(IV)\int_{0}^{1}\left[\sqrt{2x - x^{2}} + \sqrt{(1 - x^{2})^{3}}\right]\mathrm{d}x.$$
解析:
解 (I) 因 $x \cos^2 x$ 是奇函数, $\sin^2 x \cos^2 x$ 为偶函数, 故

$\begin{array}{r l} \int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} (x + \sin^ {2} x) \cos^ {2} x \mathrm{d} x & = 0 + 2 \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sin^ {2} x \cos^ {2} x \mathrm{d} x \\ & = 2 \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sin^ {2} x (1 - \sin^ {2} x) \mathrm{d} x \\ & = 2 \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sin^ {2} x \mathrm{d} x - 2 \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sin^ {4} x \mathrm{d} x \\ & = 2 \times \frac {1}{2} \times \frac {\pi}{2} - 2 \times \frac {3}{4} \times \frac {1}{2} \times \frac {\pi}{2} = \frac {\pi}{8}. \end{array}$

(Ⅱ) 令 $x^{2} = \sin t$ ，则 $2x\mathrm{d}x = \cos t\mathrm{d}t$ ，故

$\int_ {0} ^ {1} x \left(1 - x ^ {4}\right) ^ {\frac {3}{2}} \mathrm{d} x = \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \cos t \cdot \cos^ {3} t \mathrm{d} t = \frac {1}{2} \times \frac {3}{4} \times \frac {1}{2} \times \frac {\pi}{2} = \frac {3 \pi}{3 2}.$

(Ⅲ)

$\int_ {0} ^ {\pi} t \sin t \mathrm{d} t = - \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} t \mathrm{d} (\cos t) = (- t \cos t) \Big | _ {0} ^ {\pi} + \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \cos t \mathrm{d} t = \pi .$

【注】利用结论 $\int_{0}^{\pi} x f(\sin x) \mathrm{d}x = \frac{\pi}{2} \int_{0}^{\pi} f(\sin x) \mathrm{d}x$ ，有

$\int_{0}^{\pi} x \sin^{n} x \, \mathrm{d}x = \frac{\pi}{2} \int_{0}^{\pi} \sin^{n} x \, \mathrm{d}x = \pi \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \sin^{n} x \, \mathrm{d}x = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac{(n-1)!!}{n!!} \cdot \frac{\pi^{2}}{2}, & n \text{为正偶数,} \\ \frac{(n-1)!!}{n!!} \cdot \pi, & n \text{为大于1的正奇数,} \end{array} \right.$

故(Ⅲ)可利用结论求解,即 $\int_{0}^{\pi}t\sin tdt=\frac{\pi}{2}\int_{0}^{\pi}\sin tdt=\pi.$

(IV)

$\int_ {0} ^ {1} \sqrt {2 x - x ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \sqrt {1 - (x - 1) ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x \stackrel {x - 1 = t} {=} \int_ {- 1} ^ {0} \sqrt {1 - t ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} t = \frac {1}{4} \pi ,$

$\int_ {0} ^ {1} \sqrt {(1 - x ^ {2}) ^ {3}} \mathrm{d} x \xlongequal {x = \sin t} \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \cos^ {4} t \mathrm{d} t = \frac {3}{4} \times \frac {1}{2} \times \frac {\pi}{2} = \frac {3 \pi}{1 6},$

故原积分 $= \frac{\pi}{4} +\frac{3\pi}{16} = \frac{7\pi}{16}.$

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: 设 $f(x)$ 在 $[0, \pi]$ 上有二阶连续导数, $f(0) = 2, f(\pi) = 1$ , 计算 $I = \int_{0}^{\pi} [f(x) + f''(x)] \sin x \, \mathrm{d}x$ .
解析:
解

$I = \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} [ f (x) + f ^ {\prime \prime} (x) ] \sin x \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} f (x) \sin x \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} f ^ {\prime \prime} (x) \sin x \mathrm{d} x,①$

又

$\begin{array}{r l} \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} f ^ {\prime \prime} (x) \sin x \mathrm{d} x & = \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \sin x \mathrm{d} [ f ^ {\prime} (x) ] = f ^ {\prime} (x) \sin x \Big | _ {0} ^ {\pi} - \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} f ^ {\prime} (x) \cos x \mathrm{d} x \\ & = - \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} f ^ {\prime} (x) \cos x \mathrm{d} x = - \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \cos x \mathrm{d} [ f (x) ] \\ & = - f (x) \cos x \Big | _ {0} ^ {\pi} + \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} f (x) (- \sin x) \mathrm{d} x \\ & = f (\pi) + f (0) - \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} f (x) \sin x \mathrm{d} x = 3 - \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} f (x) \sin x \mathrm{d} x, \end{array}$

将结果代入式 ①, 得 I = 3.

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容:
求下列积分:
$$(I) \int_{1}^{+\infty}\frac{dx}{e^{x+1}+e^{3-x}};$$
$$(II)\int_{\frac{1}{2}}^{\frac{3}{2}}\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\sqrt{|x - x^{2}|}}.$$
解析:
解 (Ⅰ) 令 x - 1 = t，则

$\begin{array}{r l} \int_ {1} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{\mathrm{e} ^ {x + 1} + \mathrm{e} ^ {3 - x}} & = \int_ {1} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{\mathrm{e} ^ {2} (\mathrm{e} ^ {x - 1} + \mathrm{e} ^ {1 - x})} = \frac {1}{\mathrm{e} ^ {2}} \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {\mathrm{d} t}{\mathrm{e} ^ {t} + \mathrm{e} ^ {- t}} \\ & = \frac {1}{\mathrm{e} ^ {2}} \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {t}}{1 + \mathrm{e} ^ {2 t}} \mathrm{d} t = \frac {1}{\mathrm{e} ^ {2}} \arctan \left. \mathrm{e} ^ {t} \right| _ {0} ^ {+ \infty} = \frac {1}{\mathrm{e} ^ {2}} \left(\frac {\pi}{2} - \frac {\pi}{4}\right) = \frac {\pi}{4 \mathrm{e} ^ {2}}. \end{array}$

（Ⅱ）积分区间内 x = 1 是瑕点，在区间 $\left[\frac{1}{2}, 1\right)$ 和 $\left(1, \frac{3}{2}\right]$ 上分别计算积分.

$\begin{array}{r l} \int_ {\frac {1}{2}} ^ {\frac {3}{2}} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{\sqrt {| x - x ^ {2} |}} & = \int_ {\frac {1}{2}} ^ {1} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{\sqrt {x - x ^ {2}}} + \int_ {1} ^ {\frac {3}{2}} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} - x}} \\ & = \int_ {\frac {1}{2}} ^ {1} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{\sqrt {\frac {1}{4} - \left(x - \frac {1}{2}\right) ^ {2}}} + \int_ {1} ^ {\frac {3}{2}} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{\sqrt {\left(x - \frac {1}{2}\right) ^ {2} - \frac {1}{4}}} \\ & = \arcsin (2 x - 1) \Big | _ {\frac {1}{2}} ^ {1} + \ln \left[ \left(x - \frac {1}{2}\right) + \sqrt {\left(x - \frac {1}{2}\right) ^ {2} - \frac {1}{4}} \right] \Big | _ {1} ^ {\frac {3}{2}} \\ & = \frac {\pi}{2} + \ln (2 + \sqrt {3}). \end{array}$

【注】 积分公式：

$\begin{array}{l} {\int \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{\sqrt {a ^ {2} - x ^ {2}}} = \arcsin \frac {x}{a} + C,} \\ {\int \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} - a ^ {2}}} = \ln | x + \sqrt {x ^ {2} - a ^ {2}} | + C.} \end{array}$

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: 设 $f(x) = \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} |x - t| \sin t dt, x \in (-\infty, +\infty)$ ，求 $f(x)$ 的单调区间与极值.
解析:
解 当 x < 0 时, 有

$\begin{array}{r l} f (x) & = \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} (t - x) \sin t \mathrm{d} t = \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} t \sin t \mathrm{d} t - x \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sin t \mathrm{d} t \\ & = - \left(t \cos t \Big | _ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} - \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \cos t \mathrm{d} t\right) - x (- \cos t) \Big | _ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} = 1 - x. \end{array}$

同理, 当 $x > \frac{\pi}{2}$ 时, $f(x) = x - 1$ .

当 $0 \leqslant x \leqslant \frac{\pi}{2}$ 时，

故

$\begin{array}{r l} f (x) & = \int_ {0} ^ {x} (x - t) \sin t \mathrm{d} t + \int_ {x} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} (t - x) \sin t \mathrm{d} t = x - 2 \sin x + 1. \\ f (x) & = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 1 - x, & x < 0, \\ x - 2 \sin x + 1, & 0 \leqslant x \leqslant \frac {\pi}{2}, \\ x - 1, & x > \frac {\pi}{2}. \end{array} \right. \end{array}$

计算可知： $f_{-}^{\prime}(0) = f_{+}^{\prime}(0) = -1$ ， $f_{-}^{\prime}\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right) = f_{+}^{\prime}\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right) = 1.$

当 $x < 0$ 时， $f'(x) = -1$ ;

当 $x > \frac{\pi}{2}$ 时， $f'(x) = 1$ ；

当 $0 \leqslant x \leqslant \frac{\pi}{2}$ 时，由 $f'(x) = 1 - 2\cos x = 0$ ，得 $x = \frac{\pi}{3}$ .

由 $f''\left(\frac{\pi}{3}\right) = \sqrt{3} > 0$ ，知 $f\left(\frac{\pi}{3}\right) = \frac{\pi}{3} + 1 - \sqrt{3}$ 为极小值，无极大值.

故单调减少区间为 $\left(-\infty, \frac{\pi}{3}\right)$ ，单调增加区间为 $\left(\frac{\pi}{3}, +\infty\right)$ .

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: 设 $F(x)=\int_{0}^{\sin x}f(tx^{2})dt$ ，其中 $f(x)$ 为连续函数，求 $F'(x)$ ，并讨论 $F'(x)$ 在 x=0 处的连续性.
解析:
解 当 $x \neq 0$ 时，

$F (x) = \frac {1}{x ^ {2}} \int_ {0} ^ {\sin x} f (t x ^ {2}) \mathrm{d} (t x ^ {2}) \stackrel {t x ^ {2} = s} {=} \frac {1}{x ^ {2}} \int_ {0} ^ {x ^ {2} \sin x} f (s) \mathrm{d} s,$

$F ^ {\prime} (x) = - \frac {2}{x ^ {3}} \int_ {0} ^ {x ^ {2} \sin x} f (s) \mathrm{d} s + \frac {1}{x ^ {2}} f (x ^ {2} \sin x) (2 x \sin x + x ^ {2} \cos x);$

当 $x = 0$ 时，

$\begin{array}{r l} & {F ^ {\prime} (0) = \underset {x \to 0} {\lim} \frac {F (x)}{x} = \underset {x \to 0} {\lim} \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {x ^ {2} \sin x} f (s) \mathrm{d} s}{x ^ {3}}} \\ & {\quad \frac {\text {洛必达}}{\text {法则}} \underset {x \to 0} {\lim} \frac {f (x ^ {2} \sin x) (2 x \sin x + x ^ {2} \cos x)}{3 x ^ {2}}} \\ & {\quad = f (0),} \end{array}$

即 $F(x)$ 在 $x = 0$ 处可导. 故

$\begin{array}{r l} F ^ {\prime} (x) & = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} - \frac {2}{x ^ {3}} \int_ {0} ^ {x ^ {2} \sin x} f (s) \mathrm{d} s + \frac {1}{x ^ {2}} f (x ^ {2} \sin x) (2 x \sin x + x ^ {2} \cos x), & x \neq 0, \\ f (0), & x = 0. \end{array} \right. \\ & \lim\limits_ {x \to 0} F ^ {\prime} (x) = \lim\limits_ {x \to 0} \frac {- 2}{x ^ {3}} \int_ {0} ^ {x ^ {2} \sin x} f (s) \mathrm{d} s + 3 f (0) \\ & = \lim\limits_ {x \to 0} \frac {- 2}{3 x ^ {2}} f (x ^ {2} \sin x) (2 x \sin x + x ^ {2} \cos x) + 3 f (0) \\ & = - 2 \lim\limits_ {x \to 0} f (x ^ {2} \sin x) \cdot \lim\limits_ {x \to 0} \frac {2 x \sin x + x ^ {2} \cos x}{3 x ^ {2}} + 3 f (0) \\ & = f (0). \end{array}$

由 $\lim\limits_{x\to0}F'(x)=f(0)=F'(0)$ ，知 $F'(x)$ 在x=0处连续.

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: 设 $f(x)$ 在 $[0, a]$ 上有二阶导数 (a > 0)，且 $f(x) > 0, f''(x) > 0$ ，证明： $\int_{0}^{a} f(x) \, dx > af\left(\frac{a}{2}\right)$ .
解析:
证 利用泰勒公式证明. 将 $f(x)$ 在 $x = \frac{a}{2}$ 处展开为

$\begin{array}{r l} & {f (x) = f \Big (\frac {a}{2} \Big) + f ^ {\prime} \Big (\frac {a}{2} \Big) \Big (x - \frac {a}{2} \Big) + \frac {f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi)}{2 !} \Big (x - \frac {a}{2} \Big) ^ {2}} \\ & {\qquad \geqslant f \Big (\frac {a}{2} \Big) + f ^ {\prime} \Big (\frac {a}{2} \Big) \Big (x - \frac {a}{2} \Big) \quad (\xi \text {介于} \frac {a}{2} \text {与} x \text {之间}),} \end{array}$

积分得

$\begin{array}{r l} & {\int_ {0} ^ {a} f (x) \mathrm{d} x > \int_ {0} ^ {a} \left[ f \left(\frac {a}{2}\right) + f ^ {\prime} \left(\frac {a}{2}\right) \left(x - \frac {a}{2}\right) \right] \mathrm{d} x} \\ & {\qquad = \left[ f \left(\frac {a}{2}\right) \bullet x + \frac {1}{2} f ^ {\prime} \left(\frac {a}{2}\right) \left(x - \frac {a}{2}\right) ^ {2} \right] \Big | _ {0} ^ {a} = a f \left(\frac {a}{2}\right).} \end{array}$

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: 求 $f(x) = \int_{0}^{x} \frac{2t - 1}{t^2 - t + 1} dt$ 在 $[-1, 1]$ 上的最大值与最小值.

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容:
设曲线 $y = \sin x \left( 0 \leqslant x \leqslant \frac{\pi}{2} \right)$ ，直线 $y = k (0 \leqslant k \leqslant 1)$ 与 $x = 0$ 所围的面积为 $S_{1}, y = \sin x \left( 0 \leqslant x \leqslant \frac{\pi}{2} \right)$ ，
$y=k$ 与 $x=\frac{\pi}{2}$ 所围的面积为 $S_{2}$ ，求 $S=S_{1}+S_{2}$ 的最小值.
解析:
解 由已知, 如图 3-4 所示.

设 $\sin x = k\left(0 \leqslant x \leqslant \frac{\pi}{2}\right)$ , 依题意知, 两个函数图形的交点是唯一的, 则

![Image](images/80131315.jpg)

图3-4

$S _ {1} = \int_ {0} ^ {x} (k - \sin t) \mathrm{d} t = k x + \cos x - 1,$

$S _ {2} = \int_ {x} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} (\sin t - k) \mathrm{d} t = \cos x + k x - \frac {1}{2} \pi k.$

将 $k = \sin x$ 代入以上两式, 得

$S _ {1} = x \sin x + \cos x - 1, S _ {2} = \cos x + x \sin x - \frac {1}{2} \pi \sin x,$

故

$S = S _ {1} + S _ {2} = 2 (x \sin x + \cos x) - \left(1 + \frac {\pi}{2} \sin x\right) \quad \left(0 < x < \frac {\pi}{2}\right),$

则 $S^{\prime} = 2x\cos x - \frac{\pi}{2}\cos x = 0$ ，得唯一驻点 $x = \frac{\pi}{4}$ 又

$S (0) = 1, \quad S \left(\frac {\pi}{4}\right) = \sqrt {2} - 1, \quad S \left(\frac {\pi}{2}\right) = \frac {\pi}{2} - 1,$

所以 S 的最小值为 $S\left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right)=\sqrt{2}-1$ .

解析:
解（I）如图 3-5 所示，用微元法解.

任取 $[y, y + \mathrm{d}y] \subset [0, 1]$ ，则微元

$\begin{array}{r l} \mathrm{d} V _ {1} & = \left[ \pi \left(\frac {\pi}{2}\right) ^ {2} - \pi \left(\frac {\pi}{2} - x\right) ^ {2} \right] \mathrm{d} y \\ & = \left[ \pi^ {2} \arcsin y - \pi (\arcsin y) ^ {2} \right] \mathrm{d} y, \end{array}$

![Image](images/80131316.jpg)

故

$\begin{array}{r l} V _ {1} & = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm{d} V _ {1} = \pi^ {2} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \arcsin y \mathrm{d} y - \pi \int_ {0} ^ {1} (\arcsin y) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} y \\ & = \pi^ {2} \left(y \arcsin y + \sqrt {1 - y ^ {2}}\right) \Big | _ {0} ^ {1} - \pi \left[ y (\arcsin y) ^ {2} + 2 \sqrt {1 - y ^ {2}} \arcsin y - 2 y \right] \Big | _ {0} ^ {1} \\ & = \pi^ {2} \left(\frac {\pi}{2} - 1\right) - \pi \left(\frac {\pi^ {2}}{4} - 2\right) = \frac {\pi^ {3}}{4} - \pi^ {2} + 2 \pi . \end{array}$

（Ⅱ）任取 $[x, x + \mathrm{d}x] \subset [0, \pi]$ ，则微元 $\mathrm{d}V_{2} = 2\pi x \cdot \sin x \mathrm{d}x$ ，故

$V _ {2} = \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} 2 \pi x \sin x \mathrm{d} x = 2 \pi^ {2}.$

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: 设 $f(x) = \lim\limits_{n \to \infty} \frac{\ln(e^n + x^n)}{n} (x > 0)$ ，则 $F(x) = \int_{1}^{x} f(t) dt$ 在区间 $[1, +\infty)$ 上（）.
解析:
解 当 $0 < x \leqslant e$ 时, 有

$f (x) = \lim\limits_ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {\ln (\mathrm{e} ^ {n} + x ^ {n})}{n} = \lim\limits_ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {\ln \left\{\mathrm{e} ^ {n} \left[ 1 + \left(\frac {x}{\mathrm{e}}\right) ^ {n} \right]\right\}}{n} = \lim\limits_ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {n + \ln \left[ 1 + \left(\frac {x}{\mathrm{e}}\right) ^ {n} \right]}{n} = 1;$

当 $x > \mathrm{e}$ 时，有

$\begin{array}{r l} & {f (x) = \underset {n \to \infty} {\lim} \frac {\ln (\mathrm{e} ^ {n} + x ^ {n})}{n} = \underset {n \to \infty} {\lim} \frac {\ln \left\{x ^ {n} \left[ 1 + \left(\frac {\mathrm{e}}{x}\right) ^ {n} \right] \right\}}{n} = \underset {n \to \infty} {\lim} \frac {n \ln x + \ln \left[ 1 + \left(\frac {\mathrm{e}}{x}\right) ^ {n} \right]}{n} = \ln x.} \\ & {\text {故} \qquad f (x) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} {1,} & {0 < x \leqslant \mathrm{e},} \\ {\ln x,} & {x > \mathrm{e}.} \end{array} \right.} \end{array}$

由于 $f(x)$ 在 $[1, +\infty)$ 上连续，所以 $F(x) = \int_{1}^{x} f(t) \mathrm{d}t$ 可导.

由

$f _ {-} ^ {\prime} (\mathrm{e}) = \lim\limits_ {x \to \mathrm{e} ^ {-}} \frac {f (x) - f (\mathrm{e})}{x - \mathrm{e}} = 0,$

$f _ {+} ^ {\prime} (\mathrm{e}) = \lim\limits_ {x \to \mathrm{e} ^ {+}} \frac {f (x) - f (\mathrm{e})}{x - \mathrm{e}} = \lim\limits_ {x \to \mathrm{e} ^ {+}} \frac {\ln x - 1}{x - \mathrm{e}} = \frac {1}{\mathrm{e}},$

知 $f(x)$ 在 $x = \mathrm{e}$ 处不可导，故 $F(x) = \int_{1}^{x}f(t)\mathrm{d}t$ 在区间 $[1, + \infty)$ 上二阶导数不存在.

选项 C 正确.

从而 $I_{1} .$

令 $f(x) = \ln (1 + x) - \frac{\arctan x}{1 + x}$ , 则

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: 设 $I_{1} = \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \frac{\cos x}{1 + x^{2}} \mathrm{d}x, I_{2} = \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \frac{\sin x}{1 + x^{2}} \mathrm{d}x, I_{3} = \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \frac{\sin x}{(1 + x)^{2}} \mathrm{d}x,$ 则（ ）.
解析:
C.

解 当 $x \in \left[0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]$ 时， $(1 + x)^2 = 1 + x^2 + 2x \geqslant 1 + x^2$ ，故

$I _ {2} = \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \frac {\sin x}{1 + x ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x > \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \frac {\sin x}{(1 + x) ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x = I _ {3}.$

为了比较 $I_{1}$ 与 $I_{2}$ 的大小,作减法,得

$\begin{array}{r l} I _ {1} - I _ {2} & = \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \frac {\cos x - \sin x}{1 + x ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x \\ & = \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{4}} \frac {\cos x - \sin x}{1 + x ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {\frac {\pi}{4}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \frac {\cos x - \sin x}{1 + x ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x. \end{array}$

又

$\int_ {\frac {\pi}{4}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \frac {\cos x - \sin x}{1 + x ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x \xlongequal {x = \frac {\pi}{2} - t} \int_ {\frac {\pi}{4}} ^ {0} \frac {\sin t - \cos t}{1 + \left(\frac {\pi}{2} - t\right) ^ {2}} (- \mathrm{d} t) = \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{4}} \frac {\sin t - \cos t}{1 + \left(\frac {\pi}{2} - t\right) ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} t,$

故

$\begin{array}{r l} I _ {1} - I _ {2} & = \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{4}} (\cos x - \sin x) \left[ \frac {1}{1 + x ^ {2}} - \frac {1}{1 + \left(\frac {\pi}{2} - x\right) ^ {2}} \right] \mathrm{d} x \\ & = \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{4}} (\cos x - \sin x) \frac {\left(\frac {\pi}{2} - x\right) ^ {2} - x ^ {2}}{(1 + x ^ {2}) \left[ 1 + \left(\frac {\pi}{2} - x\right) ^ {2} \right]} \mathrm{d} x. \end{array}$

当 $0 < x < \frac{\pi}{4}$ 时， $\cos x > \sin x, 0 < x < \frac{\pi}{2} - x$ ，故 $I_{1} - I_{2} > 0$ .

综上所述， $I_{1}>I_{2}>I_{3}$ .选项C正确.

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: 设函数 $f(x)$ 在 $[0, a](a > 0)$ 上有二阶连续导数, 且 $f(0) = 0, f''(x) > 0$ , 则下列选项中正确的是 ( ).

$F ^ {\prime} (t) = \frac {1}{3} t f (t) - \frac {2}{3} \int_ {0} ^ {t} f (x) \mathrm{d} x, F ^ {\prime} (0) = 0,$

又由 $F(0) = 0$ ，知 $F(t) > F(0) = 0.$ 令 $t = a$ ，则 $F(a) > F(0) = 0$ ，即

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容:
设 $f(x)$ 二阶可导，则下列选项中结论正确的是（）.
①当 $f'(x)<0$ 时, $\int_{-\pi}^{\pi}f(x)\sin x\mathrm{d}x<0;$
②当 $f'(x)<0$ 时， $\int_{-\pi}^{\pi}f(x)\sin xdx>0;$
③当 $f''(x)>0$ 时， $\int_{-\pi}^{\pi}f(x)\cos xdx>0;$
④当 $f''(x)>0$ 时, $\int_{-\pi}^{\pi}f(x)\cos x\mathrm{d}x<0.$
解析:
D.

解依题意，只需判别被积函数的正、负即可.考虑到 $\sin x$ 在 $[0,\pi ]$ 与 $[- \pi ,0]$ 上分别非负和非正，故有 $\int_{-\pi}^{\pi}f(x)\sin x\mathrm{d}x = \int_{-\pi}^{0}f(x)\sin x\mathrm{d}x + \int_0^\pi f(x)\sin x\mathrm{d}x.$ 而

$\begin{array}{r l} & {\int_ {- \pi} ^ {0} f (x) \sin x \mathrm{d} x \frac {x = - u}{\pi} \int_ {\pi} ^ {0} f (- u) \sin (- u) (- \mathrm{d} u)} \\ & {\qquad = - \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} f (- u) \sin u \mathrm{d} u = - \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} f (- x) \sin x \mathrm{d} x,} \end{array}$

所以

$\int_ {- \pi} ^ {\pi} f (x) \sin x \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} [ f (x) - f (- x) ] \sin x \mathrm{d} x.$

由 $f^{\prime}(x) < 0$ ，知 $f(x)$ 单调减少，故当 $x\in [0,\pi ]$ 时，有 $f(x)\leqslant f(-x)$ ，于是

$\int_ {- \pi} ^ {\pi} f (x) \sin x \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} [ f (x) - f (- x) ] \sin x \mathrm{d} x < 0,$

故 ① 正确. 又

$\begin{array}{r l} \int_ {- \pi} ^ {\pi} f (x) \cos x \mathrm{d} x & = \int_ {- \pi} ^ {\pi} f (x) \mathrm{d} (\sin x) = f (x) \sin x \Big | _ {- \pi} ^ {\pi} - \int_ {- \pi} ^ {\pi} f ^ {\prime} (x) \sin x \mathrm{d} x \\ & = - \int_ {- \pi} ^ {\pi} f ^ {\prime} (x) \sin x \mathrm{d} x, \end{array}$

且由 $f''(x) > 0$ ，知 $f'(x)$ 单调增加，从而 $-f'(x)$ 单调减少.由 $①$ 正确，知

$\int_ {- \pi} ^ {\pi} f (x) \cos x \mathrm{d} x = - \int_ {- \pi} ^ {\pi} f ^ {\prime} (x) \sin x \mathrm{d} x < 0,$

故 ④ 正确. 综上可知, 选项 D 正确.

【注】作为选择题,可用取特殊值法,如对①、②取 $f(x)=-x$ ,对①、④取 $f(x)=\mathrm{e}^{x}$ .

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: 设反常积分 $\int_{1}^{+\infty} x^{k} \left( e^{-\cos \frac{1}{x}} - e^{-1} \right) dx$ 收敛，则下列选项中正确的是（）.
解析:
D.

解

$\mathrm{e} ^ {- \cos \frac {1}{x}} - \mathrm{e} ^ {- 1} = \mathrm{e} ^ {- 1} \left(\mathrm{e} ^ {- \cos \frac {1}{x} + 1} - 1\right).$

当 $x \to +\infty$ 时， $\mathrm{e}^{-1}\left(\mathrm{e}^{-\cos \frac{1}{x} + 1} - 1\right)$ 与 $\mathrm{e}^{-1}\left(1 - \cos \frac{1}{x}\right)$ 是等价无穷小。又 $1 - \cos \frac{1}{x}$ 与 $\frac{1}{2x^2}$ 是等价无穷小，则 $x^k\left(\mathrm{e}^{-\cos \frac{1}{x}} - \mathrm{e}^{-1}\right)$ 与 $\frac{1}{2\mathrm{e}x^{2 - k}}$ 是等价无穷小。

当 $k < 1$ 时， $2 - k > 1$ ，故 $\int_{1}^{+\infty} x^{k} \left( e^{-\cos \frac{1}{x}} - e^{-1} \right) dx$ 收敛，选项D正确.

当 $k \geqslant 1$ 时， $2 - k \leqslant 1, \frac{1}{2\mathrm{e}x^{2 - k}}$ 是阶数不高于 $\frac{1}{x}$ 的无穷小，故 $\int_{1}^{+\infty} x^k \left( \mathrm{e}^{-\cos \frac{1}{x}} - \mathrm{e}^{-1} \right) \mathrm{d}x$ 发散.

【注】结论：对于 $\int_{a}^{+\infty}\frac{1}{x^{p}}\mathrm{d}x(a>0,p$ 为任意实数），当 $p\leqslant1$ 时，发散；当p>1时，收敛于 $\frac{a^{1-p}}{p-1}$ .

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: 设 $f(x)$ 有连续导数, $f(0)=0, f'(0)=6, \alpha(x)=\int_{0}^{x^{3}}f(t)dt, \beta(x)=\left[\int_{0}^{x}f(t)dt\right]^{3}$ , 则当 $x \to 0$ 时, $\alpha(x)$ 与 $\beta(x)$ 是().
解析:
A.

解令 $g(x) = \int_{0}^{x}f(t)\mathrm{d}t$ ，则

$g (x ^ {3}) = \int_ {0} ^ {x ^ {3}} f (t) \mathrm{d} t, g ^ {\prime} (x) = f (x), g ^ {\prime \prime} (x) = f ^ {\prime} (x),$

故

$\lim\limits_ {x \to 0} \frac {g (x)}{x ^ {2}} = \lim\limits_ {x \to 0} \frac {g ^ {\prime} (x)}{2 x} = \lim\limits_ {x \to 0} \frac {g ^ {\prime \prime} (x)}{2} = \lim\limits_ {x \to 0} \frac {f ^ {\prime} (x)}{2} = \frac {f ^ {\prime} (0)}{2} = 3,$

即有 $\lim\limits_{x\to 0}\frac{g(x)}{3x^2} = 1$ ，所以 $g(x)\sim 3x^{2},g(x^{3})\sim 3(x^{3})^{2} = 3x^{6}$ ，故

$\lim\limits_ {x \to 0} \frac {\alpha (x)}{\beta (x)} = \lim\limits_ {x \to 0} \frac {3 x ^ {6}}{(3 x ^ {2}) ^ {3}} = \frac {1}{9}.$

因此选项 A 正确.

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: 下列积分存在且不为零的是 ( ).
解析:
C.

解 由 $\ln \frac{2 + x}{2 - x}$ 是关于 $x$ 的奇函数, 知 $x \ln \frac{2 + x}{2 - x}$ 是偶函数, 故

$\int_ {- 1} ^ {1} x \ln \frac {2 + x}{2 - x} \mathrm{d} x = 2 \int_ {0} ^ {1} x \ln \frac {2 + x}{2 - x} \mathrm{d} x.$

又由于 $x\ln \frac{2 + x}{2 - x}$ 在[0,1]上大于或等于零，故 $\int_{-1}^{1}x\ln \frac{2 + x}{2 - x}\mathrm{d}x > 0.$ 选项C正确

对于选项A，由于 $\int_0^1\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{(4x - 1)^3} = \int_0^{\frac{1}{4}}\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{(4x - 1)^3} +\int_{\frac{1}{4}}^{1}\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{(4x - 1)^3},$ 且

$\begin{array}{r l}\int_ {0} ^ {\frac {1}{4}} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{(4 x - 1) ^ {3}}&= \lim\limits_ {\xi \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {1}{4} - \xi} \frac {1}{4} (4 x - 1) ^ {- 3} \mathrm{d} (4 x - 1)\\&= \frac {1}{4} \lim\limits_ {\xi \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {- 1}{2 (4 x - 1) ^ {2}} \Big | _ {0} ^ {\frac {1}{4} - \xi} = - \frac {1}{8} \lim\limits_ {\xi \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \left[ \frac {1}{(- 4 \xi) ^ {2}} - 1 \right] = \infty ,\end{array}$

故 $\int_0^1\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{(4x - 1)^3}$ 发散.

对于选项 B, 由于

$\int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {x}{\sqrt {1 + x ^ {2}}} \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {0} \frac {x}{\sqrt {1 + x ^ {2}}} \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {x}{\sqrt {1 + x ^ {2}}} \mathrm{d} x,$

且 $\lim\limits_{x\to +\infty}x^{\frac{1}{2}}\cdot \frac{x}{\sqrt{1 + x^2}} = +\infty$ ，根据反常积分的比较审敛法，知 $\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}\frac{x}{\sqrt{1 + x^2}}\mathrm{d}x$ 发散.

对于选项 D, 由于 $e^{x^{2}}\sin x$ 是奇函数, 故 $\int_{-\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}e^{x^{2}}\sin xdx=0.$

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: 已知方程 $\int_{1}^{x}\frac{\ln t}{1+t}dt+\int_{1}^{\frac{1}{x}}\frac{\ln t}{1+t}dt=a(x>0)$ 有实根, 则 a 的取值范围为().
解析:
B.

解由 $\int_{1}^{\frac{1}{x}}\frac{\ln t}{1 + t}\mathrm{d}t\xlongequal{\frac{1}{t} = u}\int_{1}^{x}\frac{\ln u}{u(1 + u)}\mathrm{d}u = \int_{1}^{x}\frac{\ln t}{t}\mathrm{d}t - \int_{1}^{x}\frac{\ln t}{1 + t}\mathrm{d}t,$

知 $\int_{1}^{x}\frac{\ln t}{1 + t}\mathrm{d}t + \int_{1}^{\frac{1}{x}}\frac{\ln t}{1 + t}\mathrm{d}t = \int_{1}^{x}\frac{\ln t}{t}\mathrm{d}t = \int_{1}^{x}\ln t\mathrm{d}(\ln t) = \frac{1}{2}\ln^{2}t\Bigg|_{1}^{x} = \frac{1}{2}\ln^{2}x(x > 0).$

记 $g(x) = \frac{1}{2}\ln^2 x$ ，则由 $g'(x) = \frac{\ln x}{x} = 0$ ，得 $x = 1$ ，且当 $0 < x < 1$ 时， $g'(x) < 0$ ；当 $x > 1$ 时， $g'(x) > 0$ 。故 $g(1) = 0$ 为 $g(x)$ 的极小值。

又 $\lim\limits_{x\to 0^{+}}g(x) = \lim\limits_{x\to 0^{+}}\frac{1}{2}\ln^2 x = +\infty ,\lim\limits_{x\to +\infty}g(x) = \lim\limits_{x\to +\infty}\frac{1}{2}\ln^2 x = +\infty$ ，故由原方程有实根，知 $a\geqslant 0.$ 选项B正确.

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: 设反常积分 $\int_{0}^{+\infty}\frac{\ln(1+x)}{x^{p}}dx$ 收敛，则（）.
解析:
B.

解 当 $p \leqslant 0$ 时, $\lim\limits_{x \to +\infty} \frac{\ln(1+x)}{x^p} = +\infty$ , 故 $\int_{0}^{+\infty} \frac{\ln(1+x)}{x^p} \mathrm{d}x$ 发散.

当 $p > 0$ 时，

$\int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} {\frac {\ln (1 + x)}{x ^ {p}}} \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {1} {\frac {\ln (1 + x)}{x ^ {p}}} \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {1} ^ {+ \infty} {\frac {\ln (1 + x)}{x ^ {p}}} \mathrm{d} x {\stackrel {\text {记}} {=}} I _ {1} + I _ {2}.$

对于 $I_{1}$ ，当 $x\to0$ 时， $\frac{\ln(1+x)}{x^{p}}$ 与 $\frac{1}{x^{p-1}}$ 是等价无穷小，故当 $p-1\geqslant1$ 时， $I_{1}$ 发散；当p-1<1时， $I_{1}$ 收敛.故当$0<p<2$时， $I_{1}$ 收敛.

对于 $I_{2}$ ，当$p>1$时，总存在 $\delta>0$ ，使得 $p-\delta>1$ 。由于

$\lim\limits_ {x \to + \infty} x ^ {p - \delta} \cdot \frac {\ln (1 + x)}{x ^ {p}} = \lim\limits_ {x \to + \infty} \frac {\ln (1 + x)}{x ^ {\delta}} = 0,$

故 $I_{2}$ 收敛. 当 $0 < p \leqslant 1$ 时, 由 $\lim\limits_{x \to +\infty} x^{p} \cdot \frac{\ln(1+x)}{x^{p}} = +\infty$ , 知 $I_{2}$ 发散.

综上所述, 当 1 < p < 2 时, 原积分收敛. 选项 B 正确.

【注】 $\int_{a}^{b}\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{(x - a)^{q}} (a < b)\left\{ \begin{array}{ll}q < 1, & \text{收敛},\\ q\geqslant 1, & \text{发散}. \end{array} \right.\int_{a}^{+\infty}\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{x^p} (a > 0)\left\{ \begin{array}{ll}p > 1, & \text{收敛},\\ p\leqslant 1, & \text{发散}. \end{array} \right.$

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: 设积分 $I=\int_{1}^{+\infty}\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{x^{p}\ln^{q}x}(p>0,q>0)$ 收敛，则（）.
解析:
A.

解

$I = \int_ {1} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{x ^ {p} \ln^ {q} x} = \int_ {1} ^ {\mathrm{e}} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{x ^ {p} \ln^ {q} x} + \int_ {\mathrm{e}} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{x ^ {p} \ln^ {q} x}.$

由于 $\ln x = \ln [1 + (x - 1)]\sim x - 1(x\to 1)$ ，故 $\lim\limits_{x\to 1^{+}}\frac{\frac{1}{x^p\ln^qx}}{\frac{1}{(x - 1)^q}} = 1$ ，可知 $\int_1^{\mathrm{e}}\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{x^p\ln^qx}$ 与 $\int_1^{\mathrm{e}}\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{(x - 1)^q}$ 敛散性相同，故当 $q < 1$ 时， $\int_1^{\mathrm{e}}\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{x^p\ln^qx}$ 收敛.

当 $q < 1, p = 1$ 时， $\int_{\mathrm{e}}^{+\infty} \frac{\mathrm{d}x}{x \ln^q x} = \frac{1}{1 - q} \ln^{1 - q} x \bigg|_{\mathrm{e}}^{+\infty} = \infty$ ，故发散；

当 $q < 1, p < 1$ 时，对 $\forall p < a < 1, \lim\limits_{x \to +\infty} \frac{\frac{1}{x^p \ln^q x}}{\frac{1}{x^a}} = +\infty$ ，且 $\int_{e}^{+\infty} \frac{dx}{x^a}$ 发散，故 $\int_{e}^{+\infty} \frac{dx}{x^p \ln^q x}$ 发散；

当 $q < 1, p > 1$ 时， $\int_{\mathrm{e}}^{+\infty} \frac{\mathrm{d}x}{x^p \ln^q x} < \int_{\mathrm{e}}^{+\infty} \frac{\mathrm{d}x}{x^p}$ ，故 $\int_{\mathrm{e}}^{+\infty} \frac{\mathrm{d}x}{x^p \ln^q x}$ 收敛.

综上所述,当 p > 1, q < 1 时,积分收敛,选项 A 正确.

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: 设积分 $\int_{0}^{+\infty}\frac{x^{1-p}\arctan x}{2+x^{p}}\mathrm{d}x(p>0)$ 收敛，则 p 的取值范围为().
解析:
A.

解

$\int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} {\frac {x ^ {1 - p} \arctan x}{2 + x ^ {p}}} \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {1} {\frac {x ^ {1 - p} \arctan x}{2 + x ^ {p}}} \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {1} ^ {+ \infty} {\frac {x ^ {1 - p} \arctan x}{2 + x ^ {p}}} \mathrm{d} x {\stackrel {\text {记}} {=}} I _ {1} + I _ {2}.$

对于 $I_{1}$ ， $\lim\limits_{x\to 0^{+}}x^{-(1 - p) - 1}\cdot \frac{x^{1 - p}\arctan x}{2 + x^p} = \lim\limits_{x\to 0^{+}}\frac{1}{2 + x^p} = \frac{1}{2},$

由比较审敛法,知当 $-(1-p)-1<1$ ,即p<3时, $I_{1}$ 收敛.

对于 $I_{2}$ ， $\lim\limits_{x\to+\infty}x^{p-(1-p)}\cdot\frac{x^{1-p}\arctan x}{2+x^{p}}=\lim\limits_{x\to+\infty}\frac{x^{p}\arctan x}{2+x^{p}}=\frac{\pi}{2}$

由比较审敛法,知当 $p-(1-p)>1$ , 即 p>1 时, $I_{2}$ 收敛.

故当 1 < p < 3 时, 原积分收敛. 选项 A 正确.

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: 已知 $I=\int_{0}^{+\infty}\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{x^{2}+4}}-\frac{a}{x+2}\right)\mathrm{d}x$ 收敛，则（）.
解析:
C.

解

$\begin{array}{r l}I&= \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \left(\frac {1}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} + 4}} - \frac {a}{x + 2}\right) \mathrm{d} x = \left[ \ln \left(x + \sqrt {x ^ {2} + 4}\right) - a \ln (x + 2) \right] \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {+ \infty}\\&= \lim\limits_ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \ln \frac {x + \sqrt {x ^ {2} + 4}}{(x + 2) ^ {a}} - \ln 2 + a \ln 2.\end{array}$

当 $a > 1$ 时， $\lim\limits_{x\to +\infty}\ln \frac{x + \sqrt{x^2 + 4}}{(x + 2)^a} = \infty$ ，积分发散；

当 $a < 1$ 时， $\lim\limits_{x\to +\infty}\ln \frac{x + \sqrt{x^2 + 4}}{(x + 2)^a} = \infty$ ，积分发散；

当 $a = 1$ 时，

$I = \ln \left[ \lim\limits_ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {x + \sqrt {x ^ {2} + 4}}{(x + 2) ^ {a}} \right] - 0 = \ln \left(\lim\limits_ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {1 + \sqrt {1 + \frac {4}{x ^ {2}}}}{1 + \frac {2}{x}}\right) = \ln 2.$

选项 C 正确.

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: 设 $f(x)$ 在 $\left(0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)$ 内可导, $f(x) > 0$ , $\lim\limits_{x \to 0^{+}} f(x) = 1$ , 且 $\lim\limits_{t \to 0} \left[ \frac{f(x + t \sin x)}{f(x)} \right]^{\frac{1}{t}} = e^{\frac{\sin x - x \cos x}{x}}$ , 则 $f(x) =$ \_\_\_\_ .
解析:
$\frac{x}{\sin x}.$

解

$\lim\limits_ {t \rightarrow 0} \left[ \frac {f (x + t \sin x)}{f (x)} \right] ^ {\frac {1}{t}} = \mathrm{e} ^ {\lim\limits_ {t \rightarrow 0} \frac {1}{t} \ln \frac {f (x + t \sin x)}{f (x)}},$

又 $\lim\limits_{t\to 0}\frac{1}{t}\ln \frac{f(x + t\sin x)}{f(x)} = \lim\limits_{t\to 0}\frac{\ln f(x + t\sin x) - \ln f(x)}{t\sin x}\cdot \sin x = [\ln f(x)]'\sin x,$

由已知，有

$\mathrm{e} ^ {\left[ \ln f (x) \right] ^ {\prime} \sin x} = \mathrm{e} ^ {\frac {\sin x - x \cos x}{x}},$

即

$\left[ \ln f (x) \right] ^ {\prime} = \frac {\sin x - x \cos x}{x \sin x}.$

上式两边积分,得

$\ln f (x) = \int \left(\frac {1}{x} - \frac {\cos x}{\sin x}\right) \mathrm{d} x = \ln x - \ln \sin x + c _ {1},$

解得 $f(x) = \frac{cx}{\sin x}$ . 由 $\lim\limits_{x \to 0^{+}} f(x) = 1$ , 得 $c = 1$ .

故 $f(x)=\frac{x}{\sin x}$ .

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容:
设 $f(x)$ 在 $[0, +\infty)$ 上可导, $\ln (1 + x)$ 是 $f(x)$ 的一个原函数, 且
$$F (x) = \lim\limits_ {t \rightarrow \infty} t ^ {2} \left[ f \left(2 x + \frac {1}{t}\right) - f (2 x) \right] \sin \frac {x}{t},$$
则 $F(x)$ 在 $[0,1]$ 上的平均值为 \_\_\_\_.
解析:
$\frac{1}{6}-\frac{1}{4}\ln3.$

解

$\begin{array}{r l} F (x) & = \lim\limits_ {t \to \infty} t ^ {2} \left[ f \left(2 x + \frac {1}{t}\right) - f (2 x) \right] \sin \frac {x}{t} \\ & = \lim\limits_ {t \to \infty} \frac {x \sin \frac {x}{t}}{\frac {x}{t}} \cdot \frac {f \left(2 x + \frac {1}{t}\right) - f (2 x)}{\frac {1}{t}} = x f ^ {\prime} (2 x). \end{array}$

由已知，有 $\int f(x)\mathrm{d}x = \ln (1 + x) + C$ ，故 $f(x) = \frac{1}{1 + x}$ 所求平均值为

$\begin{array}{r l} \frac {1}{1 - 0} \int_ {0} ^ {1} F (x) \mathrm{d} x & = \int_ {0} ^ {1} x f ^ {\prime} (2 x) \mathrm{d} x = \frac {x}{2} f (2 x) \Big | _ {0} ^ {1} - \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (2 x) \mathrm{d} x \\ & = \frac {1}{2} f (2) - \frac {1}{4} \int_ {0} ^ {2} f (t) \mathrm{d} t \\ & = \frac {1}{6} - \frac {1}{4} \ln (1 + t) \Big | _ {0} ^ {2} = \frac {1}{6} - \frac {1}{4} \ln 3. \end{array}$

题目内容: 已知 $\int_{0}^{+\infty}\frac{\sin x}{x}dx=\frac{\pi}{2}$ ，则 $I=\int_{0}^{+\infty}\frac{\sin^{2}x}{x^{2}}dx=$ \_\_\_\_.

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: 反常积分 $I=\int_{1}^{+\infty}\frac{1}{\sqrt{x}}\ln\frac{x+1}{x}dx=$ \_\_\_\_.
解析:
$\pi - 2\ln 2.$

解 由于

$\begin{array}{r l} I & = \int_ {1} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {1}{\sqrt {x}} \ln \frac {x + 1}{x} \mathrm{d} x = \lim\limits_ {b \to + \infty} \int_ {1} ^ {b} \frac {1}{\sqrt {x}} \ln \frac {x + 1}{x} \mathrm{d} x \\ & = \lim\limits_ {b \to + \infty} \left[ \int_ {1} ^ {b} \frac {1}{\sqrt {x}} \ln (x + 1) \mathrm{d} x - \int_ {1} ^ {b} \frac {1}{\sqrt {x}} \ln x \mathrm{d} x \right], \end{array}$

且

$\int_{1}^{b} \frac{1}{\sqrt{x}} \ln(x + 1) \mathrm{d}x = 2\sqrt{x}\ln(x + 1) \Big|_{1}^{b} - 2\int_{1}^{b} \frac{\sqrt{x}}{x + 1} \mathrm{d}x \\
\xrightarrow{t = \sqrt{x}} 2\sqrt{b}\ln(b + 1) - 2\ln 2 - 2\int_{1}^{\sqrt{b}} \frac{2t^2}{t^2 + 1} \mathrm{d}t \\
= 2\sqrt{b}\ln(b + 1) - 2\ln 2 - (4\sqrt{b} - 4\arctan\sqrt{b} - 4 + \pi), \\

I = \lim\limits_{b \to +\infty} \left[ 2\sqrt{b}\ln\frac{b + 1}{b} + 4\arctan\sqrt{b} - 2\ln 2 - \pi \right] = \pi - 2\ln 2.$

故

$\int_ {1} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {1}{\sqrt {x}} \ln \frac {x + 1}{x} \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {1} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {1}{\sqrt {x}} \ln (x + 1) \mathrm{d} x - \int_ {1} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {1}{\sqrt {x}} \ln x \mathrm{d} x$

题目内容: $\lim\limits_{n\to\infty}\sum_{k=1}^{n}\left[\frac{k}{2n^{2}+k}+\ln\left(\frac{n+k}{n}\right)^{\frac{1}{n}}\right]=$ \_\_\_\_.

$2 \ln 2 - \frac{3}{4}$ .

解 记 $a_{n} = \sum_{k=1}^{n} \frac{k}{2n^{2} + k}, b_{n} = \sum_{k=1}^{n} \ln\left(\frac{n+k}{n}\right)^{\frac{1}{n}}$ ，则

$\frac {1}{2 n ^ {2} + n} \cdot \frac {n (n + 1)}{2} \leqslant a _ {n} \leqslant \frac {1}{2 n ^ {2} + 1} \cdot \frac {n (n + 1)}{2}.$

因 $\lim\limits_{n\to\infty}\frac{1}{2n^{2}+n}\cdot\frac{n(n+1)}{2}=\frac{1}{4},\lim\limits_{n\to\infty}\frac{1}{2n^{2}+1}\cdot\frac{n(n+1)}{2}=\frac{1}{4}$ ，故由夹逼准则，知 $\lim\limits_{n\to\infty}a_{n}=\frac{1}{4}$ .

又

$\begin{array}{r l} \lim\limits_ {n \to \infty} b _ {n} & = \lim\limits_ {n \to \infty} \frac {1}{n} \sum_ {k = 1} ^ {n} \ln \left(1 + \frac {k}{n}\right) = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \ln (1 + x) \mathrm{d} x \\ & = x \ln (1 + x) \Big | _ {0} ^ {1} - \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {x}{1 + x} \mathrm{d} x \\ & = 2 \ln 2 - 1, \end{array}$

故

原式 $= \frac{1}{4} + 2\ln 2 - 1 = 2\ln 2 - \frac{3}{4}$ .

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: $\lim\limits_{x\to0^{+}}\frac{1}{\ln\frac{1}{x}}\int_{x}^{+\infty}\frac{\mathrm{e}^{-t}}{t}dt=$ \_\_\_\_.
解析:
1.

解 由 $\lim\limits_{x\to +\infty}x^2\cdot \frac{\mathrm{e}^{-x}}{x} = \lim\limits_{x\to +\infty}\frac{x}{\mathrm{e}^x} = 0$ ，知 $\int_{a}^{+\infty}\frac{\mathrm{e}^{-t}}{t}\mathrm{d}t$ 收敛 $(a > 0)$ ，从而

$\int_ {a} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {- t}}{t} \mathrm{d} t = C \quad (\text {常数}),$

故

$\lim\limits_ {x \to 0 ^ {+}} \frac {\int_ {a} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {- t}}{t} \mathrm{d} t}{\ln \frac {1}{x}} = 0.$

因此，

$\begin{array}{r l} & {\underset {x \to 0 ^ {+}} {\lim} \frac {1}{\ln \frac {1}{x}} \int_ {x} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {- t}}{t} \mathrm{d} t = \underset {x \to 0 ^ {+}} {\lim} \frac {\int_ {x} ^ {a} \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {- t}}{t} \mathrm{d} t + \int_ {a} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {- t}}{t} \mathrm{d} t}{\ln \frac {1}{x}}} \\ & {\qquad = \underset {x \to 0 ^ {+}} {\lim} \frac {\int_ {x} ^ {a} \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {- t}}{t} \mathrm{d} t}{\ln \frac {1}{x}} \frac {\text {洛必达}}{\text {法则}} \underset {x \to 0 ^ {+}} {\lim} \frac {- \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {- x}}{x}}{- \frac {1}{x}} = 1.} \end{array}$

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: $\int_{1}^{2}\left[\frac{1}{x\ln^2x} -\frac{1}{(x - 1)^2}\right]\mathrm{d}x =$
解析:
$\frac{3}{2}-\frac{1}{\ln2}.$

解 x = 1 是奇点.

$\begin{array}{r l} \int_ {1} ^ {2} \left[ \frac {1}{x \ln^ {2} x} - \frac {1}{(x - 1) ^ {2}} \right] \mathrm{d} x & = \left(- \frac {1}{\ln x} + \frac {1}{x - 1}\right) \Bigg | _ {1} ^ {2} \\ & = \left(- \frac {1}{\ln 2} + 1\right) - \lim\limits_ {x \to 1 ^ {+}} \left(- \frac {1}{\ln x} + \frac {1}{x - 1}\right) \\ & = 1 - \frac {1}{\ln 2} - \lim\limits_ {x \to 1 ^ {+}} \frac {\ln x - (x - 1)}{(x - 1) \ln x}. \end{array}$

而

$\lim\limits_ {x \to 1 ^ {+}} \frac {\ln x - (x - 1)}{(x - 1) \ln x} = \lim\limits_ {x \to 1 ^ {+}} \frac {\frac {1}{x} - 1}{\ln x + \frac {x - 1}{x}} = \lim\limits_ {x \to 1 ^ {+}} \frac {- \frac {1}{x ^ {2}}}{\frac {1}{x} + \frac {1}{x ^ {2}}} = - \frac {1}{2},$

故原积分 $= 1 - \frac{1}{\ln 2} +\frac{1}{2} = \frac{3}{2} -\frac{1}{\ln 2}.$

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: 设 $f(x)$ 满足 $\int_{0}^{x} f(t-x) dt = x + \frac{1}{2} x^{2} + \ln |1 - x|$ ，则 $y = f(x)$ 的斜渐近线方程为 \_\_\_\_.
解析:
$y = -x + 1.$

解 由 $\int_{0}^{x} f(t - x) \, \mathrm{d}t \stackrel{t - x = u}{=} \int_{-x}^{0} f(u) \, \mathrm{d}u$ ，得

$\int_ {- x} ^ {0} f (u) \mathrm{d} u = x + \frac {1}{2} x ^ {2} + \ln | 1 - x |,$

上式两边对 x 求导, 得

$f (- x) = 1 + x + \frac {- 1}{1 - x} = \frac {- x ^ {2}}{1 - x},$

故 $f(x)=\frac{-x^{2}}{1+x}$ .

由 $\lim\limits_{x\to\infty}\frac{f(x)}{x}=-1,\lim\limits_{x\to\infty}[f(x)+x]=1$ ，知 $y=f(x)$ 的斜渐近线方程为 $y=-x+1$ .

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: 已知曲线 $y = y(x)$ 上任一点 $(x, y)$ 处的切线斜率为 $\frac{1}{x\sqrt{x^{2}-1}}$ ，且曲线通过点 $(-2, 0)$ ，则该曲线方程为 y = \_\_\_\_.
解析:
$\arcsin\frac{1}{x}+\frac{\pi}{6}(x<-1).$

解 依题设, 知 $\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{1}{x\sqrt{x^{2}-1}}$ , 故

$\begin{array}{r l} y & = \int \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{x \sqrt {x ^ {2} - 1}} = - \int \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{x ^ {2} \sqrt {1 - \frac {1}{x ^ {2}}}} = \int \frac {\mathrm{d} \left(\frac {1}{x}\right)}{\sqrt {1 - \left(\frac {1}{x}\right) ^ {2}}} \\ & = \arcsin \frac {1}{x} + c (x < - 1). \end{array}$

由 $y(-2) = 0$ ，得 $c = \frac{\pi}{6}$ 故所求曲线方程为 $y = \arcsin \frac{1}{x} +\frac{\pi}{6} (x < - 1).$

【注】 $\frac{1}{x\sqrt{x^2 - 1}}$ 的定义域为 $(- \infty, -1) \cup (1, +\infty)$ ，由于曲线通过点 $(-2,0)$ ，表明 $x \in (-\infty, -1)$ ，所以如下解法是错误的：

$y = \int \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{x \sqrt {x ^ {2} - 1}} = - \int \frac {\mathrm{d} \left(\frac {1}{x}\right)}{\sqrt {1 - \left(\frac {1}{x}\right) ^ {2}}} = \arccos \frac {1}{x} + c.$

由 $y(-2) = 0$ ，得 $c = -\frac{2}{3}\pi$ ，故 $y = \arccos \frac{1}{x} -\frac{2}{3}\pi .$ 事实上，

$y = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \arcsin \frac {1}{x} + \frac {\pi}{6}, & x < - 1, \\ \arccos \frac {1}{x} + c, & x > 1. \end{array} \right.$

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: 设 $f(t)=\lim\limits_{n\to\infty}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\frac{t-1}{[n+(t-1)i]\sqrt{\frac{t-1}{n}i}}$ $(t>1)$，则 $\lim\limits_{t\to+\infty}f(t)=$ \_\_\_\_.
解析:
$\pi$ .

解 因为

$f (t)  = \lim\limits_ {n \to \infty} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \frac {t - 1}{[ n + (t - 1) i ] \sqrt {\frac {t - 1}{n} i}} = \lim\limits_ {n \to \infty} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \frac {t - 1}{n \left(1 + \frac {t - 1}{n} i\right) \sqrt {1 + \frac {t - 1}{n} i - 1}}   \\= \lim\limits_ {n \to \infty} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \frac {\frac {t - 1}{n}}{\left(1 + \frac {t - 1}{n} i\right) \sqrt {1 + \frac {t - 1}{n} i - 1}} = \int_ {1} ^ {t} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{x \sqrt {x - 1}},$

故

$\lim\limits_{t \to +\infty} f(t) = \lim\limits_{t \to +\infty} \int_{1}^{t} \frac{\mathrm{d}x}{x\sqrt{x-1}} = \int_{1}^{+\infty} \frac{\mathrm{d}x}{x\sqrt{x-1}} = \int_{1}^{2} \frac{\mathrm{d}x}{x\sqrt{x-1}} + \int_{2}^{+\infty} \frac{\mathrm{d}x}{x\sqrt{x-1}} \\
= \lim\limits_{\xi \to 0^+} \int_{1+\xi}^{2} \frac{2\mathrm{d}(\sqrt{x-1})}{1+(\sqrt{x-1})^2} + \lim\limits_{b \to +\infty} \int_{2}^{b} \frac{2\mathrm{d}(\sqrt{x-1})}{1+(\sqrt{x-1})^2} \\
= \lim\limits_{\xi \to 0^+} 2\arctan\sqrt{x-1} \Big|_{1+\xi}^{2} + \lim\limits_{b \to +\infty} 2\arctan\sqrt{x-1} \Big|_{2}^{b} \\
= \lim\limits_{\xi \to 0^+} \left(\frac{\pi}{2} - 2\arctan\sqrt{\xi}\right) + \lim\limits_{b \to +\infty} 2\arctan\sqrt{b-1} - \frac{\pi}{2} \\
= \frac{\pi}{2} - 0 + \pi - \frac{\pi}{2} = \pi  .$

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容:
求下列积分:
(I) 设 $f(x)=\int_{1}^{x}\frac{dt}{\sqrt{1+t^{4}}}$ ，求 $I=\int_{0}^{1}x^{2}f(x)\mathrm{d}x;$
(II) 设 $f(x) = \int_{1}^{x^2} \mathrm{e}^{-t^2} dt$ , 求 $I = \int_{0}^{1} x f(x) \, \mathrm{d}x$ .
解析:
解 (I) 依题设, 有

$\begin{array}{r l} I & = \int_ {0} ^ {1} x ^ {2} f (x) \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (x) \mathrm{d} \left(\frac {x ^ {3}}{3}\right) = \frac {1}{3} x ^ {3} f (x) \Big | _ {0} ^ {1} - \frac {1}{3} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {x ^ {3} \mathrm{d} x}{\sqrt {1 + x ^ {4}}} \\ & = - \frac {1}{6} (1 + x ^ {4}) ^ {\frac {1}{2}} \Big | _ {0} ^ {1} = \frac {1}{6} (1 - \sqrt {2}). \end{array}$

(Ⅱ)依题设,有

$\begin{array}{r l} I & = \int_ {0} ^ {1} x f (x) \mathrm{d} x = \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (x) \mathrm{d} (x ^ {2}) = \frac {1}{2} x ^ {2} f (x) \Big | _ {0} ^ {1} - \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {1} x ^ {2} f ^ {\prime} (x) \mathrm{d} x \\ & = - \int_ {0} ^ {1} x ^ {3} \mathrm{e} ^ {- x ^ {4}} \mathrm{d} x = \frac {1}{4} \mathrm{e} ^ {- x ^ {4}} \Big | _ {0} ^ {1} = \frac {1}{4} (\mathrm{e} ^ {- 1} - 1), \end{array}$

这里 $f(1)=0$ .

【注】积分 $\int \frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\sqrt{1 + x^4}},\int \mathrm{e}^{\pm x^2}\mathrm{d}x,\int \frac{\sin x}{x}\mathrm{d}x,\int \frac{\cos x}{x}\mathrm{d}x$ 俗称“积不出来”，即原函数不能用初等函数表达.

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: 设 $f(\sin^2 x) = \frac{x}{\sin x}$ ，求 $I = \int \frac{\sqrt{x}}{\sqrt{1 - x}} f(x) \, \mathrm{d}x$ .
解析:
解 令 $\sin^2 x = t$ ，则 $\sin x = \pm \sqrt{t}$ ，由 $\sqrt{x} \geqslant 0, \sqrt{1 - x} \geqslant 0$ ，可知 $x \geqslant 0, 1 - x \geqslant 0$ ，故 $0 \leqslant x \leqslant 1$ ，所以 $\sin x \geqslant 0$ 。取 $\sin x = \sqrt{t}$ ，则 $x = \arcsin \sqrt{t}, f(t) = \frac{\arcsin \sqrt{t}}{\sqrt{t}}$ ，故

$I  = \int \frac {\sqrt {x}}{\sqrt {1 - x}} f (x) \mathrm{d} x = \int \frac {\sqrt {x}}{\sqrt {1 - x}} \cdot \frac {\arcsin \sqrt {x}}{\sqrt {x}} \mathrm{d} x \\  = - \int \frac {\arcsin \sqrt {x}}{\sqrt {1 - x}} \mathrm{d} (1 - x) = - 2 \int \arcsin \sqrt {x} \mathrm{d} (\sqrt {1 - x}) \\  = - 2 \sqrt {1 - x} \arcsin \sqrt {x} + 2 \int \sqrt {1 - x} \mathrm{d} (\arcsin \sqrt {x}) \\  = - 2 \sqrt {1 - x} \arcsin \sqrt {x} + 2 \sqrt {x} + C.$

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: 计算积分 $I=\int e^{\sin x}\cdot\frac{x\cos^{3}x-\sin x}{\cos^{2}x}dx.$
解析:
解

$I  = \int \mathrm{e} ^ {\sin x} \left(x \cos x - \frac {\sin x}{\cos^ {2} x}\right) \mathrm{d} x = \int x \cos x \mathrm{e} ^ {\sin x} \mathrm{d} x - \int \mathrm{e} ^ {\sin x} \cdot \frac {\sin x}{\cos^ {2} x} \mathrm{d} x \\  = \int x \mathrm{d} (\mathrm{e} ^ {\sin x}) + \int \mathrm{e} ^ {\sin x} \mathrm{d} \left(- \frac {1}{\cos x}\right) \\  = x \mathrm{e} ^ {\sin x} - \int \mathrm{e} ^ {\sin x} \mathrm{d} x - \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {\sin x}}{\cos x} + \int \mathrm{e} ^ {\sin x} \cos x \cdot \frac {1}{\cos x} \mathrm{d} x \\  = x \mathrm{e} ^ {\sin x} - \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {\sin x}}{\cos x} + C.$

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: 计算积分 $I = \int \frac{\mathrm{e}^{-\sin x} \cdot \sin 2x}{\sin^4 \left( \frac{\pi}{4} - \frac{x}{2} \right)} \, \mathrm{d}x.$
解析:
解

$I  = \int \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {- \sin x} \cdot 2 \sin x \cos x}{\left[ \sin^ {2} \left(\frac {\pi}{4} - \frac {x}{2}\right) \right] ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x = \int \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {- \sin x} \cdot 2 \sin x \cos x}{\left[ 1 - \cos \left(\frac {\pi}{2} - x\right) \right] ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x \\  = 8 \int \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {- \sin x} (- \sin x) \mathrm{d} (- \sin x)}{(1 - \sin x) ^ {2}} \frac {- \sin x = u}{- \sin x = u} 8 \int \mathrm{e} ^ {u} \cdot \frac {u}{(1 + u) ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} u \\  = 8 \int \mathrm{e} ^ {u} \left[ \frac {1}{1 + u} - \frac {1}{(1 + u) ^ {2}} \right] \mathrm{d} u = 8 \left[ \int \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {u}}{1 + u} \mathrm{d} u - \int \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {u}}{(1 + u) ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} u \right] \\  = 8 \left(\int \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {u}}{1 + u} \mathrm{d} u + \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {u}}{1 + u} - \int \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {u}}{1 + u} \mathrm{d} u\right) + C \\  = \frac {8 \mathrm{e} ^ {u}}{1 + u} + C = \frac {8 \mathrm{e} ^ {- \sin x}}{1 - \sin x} + C.$

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: 设 $f(\ln x) = \frac{\ln(1 + x)}{x}$ ，求 $I = \int f(x) \, \mathrm{d}x$ .
解析:
解 令 $\ln x = t$ ，则 $x = \mathrm{e}^{t}$ ，故 $f(t) = f(\ln x) = \frac{\ln(1 + \mathrm{e}^{t})}{\mathrm{e}^{t}}$

$I  = \int f (x) \mathrm{d} x = \int \frac {\ln (1 + \mathrm{e} ^ {x})}{\mathrm{e} ^ {x}} \mathrm{d} x = - \int \ln (1 + \mathrm{e} ^ {x}) \mathrm{d} (\mathrm{e} ^ {- x}) \\  = - \mathrm{e} ^ {- x} \ln (1 + \mathrm{e} ^ {x}) + \int \left(1 - \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {x}}{1 + \mathrm{e} ^ {x}}\right) \mathrm{d} x \\  = x - (1 + \mathrm{e} ^ {- x}) \ln (1 + \mathrm{e} ^ {x}) + C.$

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: 设 $f'(x) = \arctan(x - 1)^2, f(0) = 0$ , 求 $I = \int_0^1 f(x) \, \mathrm{d}x$ .

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: 设 $f(x)$ 为连续的非负函数，且满足 $f(x)\int_{0}^{x}f(x - t)dt = \cos^4 x + x - 1$ ，求 $\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}f(x)\mathrm{d}x$ .
解析:
解

$\int_ {0} ^ {x} f (x - t) \mathrm{d} t \stackrel {x - t = u} {=} \int_ {0} ^ {x} f (u) \mathrm{d} u,$

故将已知等式变为

$f (x) \int_ {0} ^ {x} f (u) \mathrm{d} u = \cos^ {4} x + x - 1.$

令 $F(x) = \int_{0}^{x}f(u)\mathrm{d}u$ ，则上式变为 $F^{\prime}(x)F(x) = \cos^4 x + x - 1$ ，两边积分，得

$\int F ^ {\prime} (x) F (x) \mathrm{d} x = \int (\cos^ {4} x + x - 1) \mathrm{d} x,$

即 $\frac{1}{2} F^2 (x) + C_1 = \int \cos^4 x\mathrm{d}x + \frac{1}{2} (x - 1)^2 +C_2$ ，而

$\int \cos^ {4} x \mathrm{d} x = \int \left(\frac {1 + \cos 2 x}{2}\right) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x = \frac {1}{4} \left(\frac {3}{2} x + \sin 2 x + \frac {1}{8} \sin 4 x\right) + C _ {3},$

$\text {所以} \frac {1}{2} F ^ {2} (x) = \frac {1}{4} \left(\frac {3}{2} x + \sin 2 x + \frac {1}{8} \sin 4 x\right) + \frac {1}{2} (x - 1) ^ {2} + C (C = C _ {2} + C _ {3} - C _ {1}).$

令 $x = 0$ ，得 $C = -\frac{1}{2}$ 故

$\frac {1}{2} \left[ \int_ {0} ^ {x} f (u) \mathrm{d} u \right] ^ {2} = \frac {1}{4} \left(\frac {3}{2} x + \sin 2 x + \frac {1}{8} \sin 4 x\right) + \frac {1}{2} (x - 1) ^ {2} - \frac {1}{2},$

再令 $x = \frac{\pi}{2}$ , 得 $\left[\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} f(u) \mathrm{d}u\right]^{2} = \frac{\pi(2\pi - 5)}{8}$ , 故 $\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} f(x) \mathrm{d}x = \sqrt{\frac{\pi(2\pi - 5)}{8}}$ .

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: 求极限 $\lim\limits_{x\to0}\frac{\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{2}x\sqrt{4-x^{2}u^{2}}\mathrm{d}u-2x}{\sqrt{1+2x^{3}}-1}$ .
解析:
解 当 $x \to 0$ 时, $\sqrt{1 + 2x^3} - 1 \sim \frac{1}{2} \cdot 2x^3 = x^3$ , 又

$\frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {2} x \sqrt {4 - x ^ {2} u ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} u \xlongequal {x u = t} \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {2 x} \sqrt {4 - t ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} t,$

所以

$\begin{array}{r l} \text {原式} & = \lim\limits_ {x \to 0} \frac {\frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {2 x} \sqrt {4 - t ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} t - 2 x}{x ^ {3}} = \lim\limits_ {x \to 0} \frac {\frac {1}{2} \sqrt {4 - 4 x ^ {2}} \cdot 2 - 2}{3 x ^ {2}} \\ & = \lim\limits_ {x \to 0} \frac {2 (\sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}} - 1)}{3 x ^ {2}} = \lim\limits_ {x \to 0} \frac {2 \cdot \frac {1}{2} (- x ^ {2})}{3 x ^ {2}} = - \frac {1}{3}. \end{array}$

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: 设 $f(x)$ 连续, $\lim\limits_{x\to 0}\frac{f(x)}{x} = 2$ , 求 $\lim\limits_{x\to 0}\frac{\int_0^x f(x)f(x - t)dt}{\int_0^x tf(x - t)dt}$ .
解析:
解 由于

$\int_ {0} ^ {x} f (x - t) \mathrm{d} t \stackrel {x - t = u} {=} \int_ {x} ^ {0} f (u) (- \mathrm{d} u) = \int_ {0} ^ {x} f (u) \mathrm{d} u,$

$\int_ {0} ^ {x} t f (x - t) \mathrm{d} t \stackrel {x - t = u} {=} \int_ {x} ^ {0} f (u) \bullet (x - u) (- \mathrm{d} u) = x \int_ {0} ^ {x} f (u) \mathrm{d} u - \int_ {0} ^ {x} u f (u) \mathrm{d} u,$

故

$\begin{array}{r l} \lim\limits_ {x \to 0} \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {x} f (x) f (x - t) \mathrm{d} t}{\int_ {0} ^ {x} t f (x - t) \mathrm{d} t} & = \lim\limits_ {x \to 0} \frac {f (x) \int_ {0} ^ {x} f (x - t) \mathrm{d} t}{\int_ {0} ^ {x} t f (x - t) \mathrm{d} t} = \lim\limits_ {x \to 0} \frac {f (x)}{x} \cdot \frac {x \int_ {0} ^ {x} f (x - t) \mathrm{d} t}{\int_ {0} ^ {x} t f (x - t) \mathrm{d} t} \\ & = 2 \lim\limits_ {x \to 0} \frac {x \int_ {0} ^ {x} f (x - t) \mathrm{d} t}{\int_ {0} ^ {x} t f (x - t) \mathrm{d} t} \overset {x - t = u} {=} 2 \lim\limits_ {x \to 0} \frac {x \int_ {0} ^ {x} f (u) \mathrm{d} u}{x \int_ {0} ^ {x} f (u) \mathrm{d} u - \int_ {0} ^ {x} u f (u) \mathrm{d} u} \\ & = 2 \lim\limits_ {x \to 0} \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {x} f (u) \mathrm{d} u + x f (x)}{\int_ {0} ^ {x} f (u) \mathrm{d} u} = 2 + 2 \lim\limits_ {x \to 0} \frac {\frac {f (x)}{x}}{\frac {\int_ {0} ^ {x} f (u) \mathrm{d} u}{x ^ {2}}}. \end{array}$

又由于 $\lim\limits_{x\to0}\frac{\int_{0}^{x}f(u)\mathrm{d}u}{x^{2}}=\lim\limits_{x\to0}\frac{f(x)}{2x}=\frac{1}{2}\times2=1$ ，故原式 $=2+2\times\frac{2}{1}=6$ .

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学

解析:

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: 设 $f(x)$ 在 $(- \infty, 0]$ 上连续，且满足 $\int_{0}^{x} t f(t^2 - x^2) dt = \frac{x^2}{1 + x^2} - \frac{1}{2} \ln (1 + x^2)$ ，求函数 $f(x)$ 及其极值.

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: 设 $f(x)$ 在 $[1, +\infty)$ 上可导, $f(1) = 2$ , 且满足 $\lim\limits_{t \to 0} \frac{f[(x + t)^2] - f(x^2 + t)}{(2x - 1)t} = 1 - 2\ln x$ , 求 $f(x)$ 及其极值.
解析:
解 由 $\lim\limits_{t\to 0}\frac{f[(x + t)^2] - f(x^2 + t)}{(2x - 1)t} = 1 - 2\ln x$ ，有 $\lim\limits_{t\to 0}\frac{f[(x + t)^2] - f(x^2 + t)}{t} = (2x - 1)(1 - 2\ln x)$ ，

而

$\lim\limits_ {t \to 0} \frac {f [ (x + t) ^ {2} ] - f (x ^ {2} + t)}{t}  = \lim\limits_ {t \to 0} \frac {f [ (x + t) ^ {2} ] - f (x ^ {2})}{t} - \lim\limits_ {t \to 0} \frac {f (x ^ {2} + t) - f (x ^ {2})}{t} \\ = f ^ {\prime} (x ^ {2}) \cdot 2 x - f ^ {\prime} (x ^ {2}) = f ^ {\prime} (x ^ {2}) (2 x - 1),$

故 $f^{\prime}(x^{2})(2x - 1) = (2x - 1)(1 - 2\ln x)$ ，从而 $f^{\prime}(x^{2}) = 1 - \ln x^{2}$ ，于是 $f^{\prime}(x) = 1 - \ln x$

$f (x) = \int (1 - \ln x) \mathrm{d} x = x - \int \ln x \mathrm{d} x = 2 x - x \ln x + c.$

由 $f(1)=2$ , 得 c=0 , 故 $f(x)=2x-x\ln x$ .

令 $f'(x)=1-\ln x=0$ , 得 x=e ，又由 $f''(e)=-\frac{1}{e}<0$ ，知 $f(e)=e$ 为 $f(x)$ 的极大值，无极小值.

$\lim\limits_ {t \to 0} \frac {f [ (x + t) ^ {2} ] - f (x ^ {2})}{t} = \lim\limits_ {t \to 0} \frac {f (x ^ {2} + 2 x t + t ^ {2}) - f (x ^ {2})}{2 x t + t ^ {2}} \cdot \frac {2 x t + t ^ {2}}{t} = f ^ {\prime} (x ^ {2}) \cdot 2 x.$

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: 求极限 $\lim\limits_{x\to0}\frac{\int_{0}^{2x}\left|1-\frac{t}{x}\right|\sin tdt}{x^{2}}$ .
解析:
解

$\int_ {0} ^ {2 x} \left| 1 - \frac {t}{x} \right| \sin t \mathrm{d} t = \frac {\frac {t}{x} = u}{x} \int_ {0} ^ {2} | 1 - u | \sin (x u) \mathrm{d} u,$

$\text {原式}  = \lim\limits_ {x \to 0} \frac {x \int_ {0} ^ {2} | 1 - u | \sin (x u) \mathrm{d} u}{x ^ {2}} \\  = \lim\limits_ {x \to 0} \frac {1}{x} \left[ \int_ {0} ^ {1} (1 - u) \sin (x u) \mathrm{d} u + \int_ {1} ^ {2} (u - 1) \sin (x u) \mathrm{d} u \right].$

利用分部积分法,可得

$\text {原式} = \lim\limits_ {x \to 0} \frac {1}{x} \Big (\frac {1 - \cos 2 x}{x} + \frac {\sin 2 x - 2 \sin x}{x ^ {2}} \Big) \\  = \lim\limits_ {x \to 0} \Big (\frac {1 - \cos 2 x}{x ^ {2}} + \frac {\sin 2 x - 2 \sin x}{x ^ {3}} \Big) \\  = \lim\limits_ {x \to 0} \frac {\frac {1}{2} \cdot (2 x) ^ {2}}{x ^ {2}} + \lim\limits_ {x \to 0} \frac {2 (\cos x - 1) \sin x}{x ^ {3}} = 2 - 1 = 1.$

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: 设可导函数 $y = f(x)$ 由方程 $\mathrm{e}^{x - 2y} - x^2 y = 1$ 确定，计算 $\lim\limits_{x\to 1^+}\frac{\sin(x - 1)}{\sqrt{(x - 1)^3}}\int_0^1 f(t\sqrt{x - 1})dt.$
解析:
解 由 $e^{x-2y}-x^{2}y=1$ ，知当 x=0 时，y=0，即 $f(0)=0$ .

等式 $\mathrm{e}^{x - 2y} - x^2 y = 1$ 两边对 $x$ 求导，有

$\mathrm{e} ^ {x - 2 y} (1 - 2 y ^ {\prime}) - 2 x y - x ^ {2} y ^ {\prime} = 0,$

将 x = 0, y = 0 代入上式, 得 $f'(0) = y'(0) = \frac{1}{2}$ .

又 $\int_0^1 f(t\sqrt{x - 1})\mathrm{d}t\xlongequal {t\sqrt{x - 1} = u}\frac{1}{\sqrt{x - 1}}\int_0^{\sqrt{x - 1}}f(u)\mathrm{d}u$ ，故

$\begin{array}{r l} \lim\limits_ {x \to 1 ^ {+}} \frac {\sin (x - 1)}{\sqrt {(x - 1) ^ {3}}} \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (t \sqrt {x - 1}) \mathrm{d} t & = \lim\limits_ {x \to 1 ^ {+}} \frac {\sin (x - 1)}{(x - 1) ^ {2}} \int_ {0} ^ {\sqrt {x - 1}} f (u) \mathrm{d} u \\ & = \lim\limits_ {x \to 1 ^ {+}} \frac {\sin (x - 1)}{x - 1} \cdot \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {\sqrt {x - 1}} f (u) \mathrm{d} u}{x - 1} \\ & = \lim\limits_ {x \to 1 ^ {+}} \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {\sqrt {x - 1}} f (u) \mathrm{d} u}{x - 1} = \lim\limits_ {x \to 1 ^ {+}} \frac {f (\sqrt {x - 1})}{2 \sqrt {x - 1}} \\ & = \frac {1}{2} \lim\limits_ {x \to 1 ^ {+}} \frac {f (\sqrt {x - 1}) - f (0)}{\sqrt {x - 1} - 0} = \frac {1}{2} f ^ {\prime} (0) = \frac {1}{4}. \end{array}$

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: 设 $f(x)$ 满足 $e^{-x} - \frac{x^2}{2} = 1 + \int_0^x f(t - x)dt$ , 求 $f(x)$ 在 $(-\infty, +\infty)$ 内的最值.
解析:
解

$\int_ {0} ^ {x} f (t - x) \mathrm{d} t \stackrel {t - x = u} {=} \int_ {- x} ^ {0} f (u) \mathrm{d} u.$

由已知，有 $\mathrm{e}^{-x} - \frac{x^2}{2} = 1 + \int_{-x}^{0}f(u)\mathrm{d}u$ ，等式两边同时对 $x$ 求导，得 $-\mathrm{e}^{-x} - x = f(-x)$ ，故

$f (x) = x - \mathrm{e} ^ {x}, \quad x \in (- \infty , + \infty).$

由 $f'(x)=1-\mathrm{e}^{x}=0$ ，解得 x=0 。当 x>0 时， $f'(x)<0$ ；当 x<0 时， $f'(x)>0$ ， $f(0)=-1$ 为极大值。

又 $\lim\limits_{x\to -\infty}f(x) = -\infty ,\lim\limits_{x\to +\infty}f(x) = -\infty$ ，故在 $(- \infty , + \infty)$ 内 $f(x)$ 的最大值为 $f(0) = -1$ ，没有最小值.

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: 证明: $\lim\limits_{n\to\infty}\int_{0}^{1}\frac{x^{n}}{1+x}dx=0.$
解析:
证法1 利用夹逼准则证明. 当 $x \in [0,1]$ 时, 有 $0 \leqslant \frac{x^n}{1 + x} \leqslant x^n$ .

根据定积分的性质, 得 $0 \leqslant \int_{0}^{1} \frac{x^{n}}{1 + x} dx \leqslant \int_{0}^{1} x^{n} dx = \frac{1}{n + 1}$ , 故 $\lim\limits_{n \to \infty} \int_{0}^{1} \frac{x^{n}}{1 + x} dx = 0$ .

证法2 利用推广的积分中值定理,有

$\int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {x ^ {n}}{1 + x} \mathrm{d} x = \frac {1}{1 + \xi} \int_ {0} ^ {1} x ^ {n} \mathrm{d} x = \frac {1}{(1 + \xi) (1 + n)} \quad (0 < \xi < 1),$

故

$\lim\limits_ {n \to \infty} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {x ^ {n}}{1 + x} \mathrm{d} x = \lim\limits_ {n \to \infty} \frac {1}{(1 + \xi) (1 + n)} = 0.$

【注】推广的第一积分中值定理: 设 $f(x)$ 在 $[a, b]$ 上连续, $g(x)$ 在 $[a, b]$ 上可积且不变号, 则至少存在一点 $\xi \in (a, b)$ , 使得

$\int_ {a} ^ {b} f (x) g (x) \mathrm{d} x = f (\xi) \int_ {a} ^ {b} g (x) \mathrm{d} x.$

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: 求极限 $\lim\limits_{n\to\infty}\left(\frac{2^{\frac{1}{n}}}{n+1}+\frac{2^{\frac{2}{n}}}{n+\frac{1}{2}}+\cdots+\frac{2^{\frac{n}{n}}}{n+\frac{1}{n}}\right)$ .
解析:
解 令 $x_{n} = \frac{2^{\frac{1}{n}}}{n + 1} + \frac{2^{\frac{2}{n}}}{n + \frac{1}{2}} + \cdots + \frac{2^{\frac{n}{n}}}{n + \frac{1}{n}}$ ，则

$\frac {n}{n + 1} \left(2 ^ {\frac {1}{n}} + 2 ^ {\frac {2}{n}} + \dots + 2 ^ {\frac {n}{n}}\right) \frac {1}{n} \leqslant x _ {n} \leqslant \frac {1}{n} \left(2 ^ {\frac {1}{n}} + 2 ^ {\frac {2}{n}} + \dots + 2 ^ {\frac {n}{n}}\right).$

由定积分的定义,有

$\lim\limits_ {n \rightarrow \infty} \left(2 ^ {\frac {1}{n}} + 2 ^ {\frac {2}{n}} + \dots + 2 ^ {\frac {n}{n}}\right) \frac {1}{n} = \int_ {0} ^ {1} 2 ^ {x} \mathrm{d} x = \frac {2 ^ {x}}{\ln 2} \Big | _ {0} ^ {1} = \frac {1}{\ln 2},$

而 $\lim\limits_{n\to \infty}\frac{n}{n + 1} = 1$ ，由夹逼准则，知 $\lim\limits_{n\to \infty}x_n = \frac{1}{\ln 2}.$

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: 求极限 $\lim\limits_{n\to\infty}\frac{1}{n}\sqrt[n]{n(n+1)(n+2)\cdots(2n-1)}$ .
解析:
解 令 $x_{n} = \frac{1}{n}\sqrt[n]{n(n + 1)(n + 2)\cdots(2n - 1)}$ ，则

$x _ {n} = \sqrt [ n ]{\frac {n}{n} \cdot \frac {n + 1}{n} \cdot \frac {n + 2}{n} \cdot \dots \cdot \frac {n + (n - 1)}{n}},$

即 $\ln x_{n} = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{k = 0}^{n - 1}\ln \left(1 + \frac{k}{n}\right)$ ，故

$\lim\limits_ {n \rightarrow \infty} \ln x _ {n} = \lim\limits_ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {1}{n} \sum_ {k = 0} ^ {n - 1} \ln \left(1 + \frac {k}{n}\right) = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \ln (1 + x) d x = 2 \ln 2 - 1 = \ln \frac {4}{e}.$

综上可知,原极限= $\frac{4}{e}$ .

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: 设 $\int_{0}^{+\infty} f(x) \mathrm{d}x$ 收敛, 且 $f(x) = \frac{1}{1 + x^2} - \frac{\mathrm{e}^{-x}}{1 + \mathrm{e}^x} \int_{0}^{+\infty} f(x) \mathrm{d}x$ , 求 $\int_{0}^{+\infty} f(x) \mathrm{d}x$ .
解析:
解 由于 $\int_{0}^{+\infty} f(x) \mathrm{d}x$ 收敛, 故记 $\int_{0}^{+\infty} f(x) = A (A$ 为常数). 对已知等式两端分别积分, 得

$A = \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} f (x) \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {1}{1 + x ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x - A \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {- x}}{1 + \mathrm{e} ^ {x}} \mathrm{d} x,$

其中 $\int_{0}^{+\infty}\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{1 + x^2} = \arctan x\Big|_{0}^{+\infty} = \frac{\pi}{2}.$ 又

$\begin{array}{r l} \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {- x}}{1 + \mathrm{e} ^ {x}} \mathrm{d} x & = \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{\mathrm{e} ^ {x} (1 + \mathrm{e} ^ {x})} = \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \left(\frac {1}{\mathrm{e} ^ {x}} - \frac {1}{\mathrm{e} ^ {x} + 1}\right) \mathrm{d} x \\ & = - \left. \mathrm{e} ^ {- x} \right| _ {0} ^ {+ \infty} - \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {- x}}{1 + \mathrm{e} ^ {- x}} \mathrm{d} x \\ & = 1 + \ln (1 + \mathrm{e} ^ {- x}) \Big | _ {0} ^ {+ \infty} = 1 - \ln 2, \end{array}$

故 $A = \frac{\pi}{2} -(1 - \ln 2)A$ ，解得 $A = \int_0^{+\infty}f(x)\mathrm{d}x = \frac{\pi}{2(2 - \ln 2)}.$

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容:
设 $a_{n}=\int_{0}^{\pi}x\sin^{n}x\mathrm{d}x(n=1,2,\cdots)$ .
(I) 证明: $a_{n}=\frac{n-1}{n}a_{n-2}(n=3,4,\cdots);$
(II) 求 $\lim\limits_{n\to \infty}\frac{a_n}{a_{n - 1}}.$
解析:
证 (I)

$\begin{array}{r l} a _ {n} & = \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} x \sin^ {n} x \mathrm{d} x = - \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} x \sin^ {n - 1} x \mathrm{d} (\cos x) \\ & = \left(- x \sin^ {n - 1} x \cos x\right) \Big | _ {0} ^ {\pi} + \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} [ \sin^ {n - 1} x + x (n - 1) \sin^ {n - 2} x \cos x ] \cos x \mathrm{d} x \\ & = \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \sin^ {n - 1} x \mathrm{d} (\sin x) + (n - 1) \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} x \sin^ {n - 2} x (1 - \sin^ {2} x) \mathrm{d} x \\ & = \frac {1}{n} \sin^ {n} x \Big | _ {0} ^ {\pi} + (n - 1) \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} x \sin^ {n - 2} x \mathrm{d} x - (n - 1) \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} x \sin^ {n} x \mathrm{d} x \\ & = (n - 1) a _ {n - 2} - (n - 1) a _ {n}, \end{array}$

移项得 $a_{n}=\frac{n-1}{n}a_{n-2}$ .

解（Ⅱ）证明数列 $\{a_{n}\}$ 单调减少.因

$a_{n + 1} - a_n = \int_0^\pi x\sin^n x(\sin x - 1)\mathrm{d}x < 0$ （因在 $(0,\pi)$ 内， $x\sin^n x > 0,\sin x - 1 < 0)$

故 $\{a_{n}\}$ 单调减少，从而 $a_{n} < a_{n - 1} < a_{n - 2}$ . 又由 $a_{n}$ 的表达式知 $a_{n} > 0$ ，故有

$\frac {n - 1}{n} = \frac {a _ {n}}{a _ {n - 2}} < \frac {a _ {n}}{a _ {n - 1}} < \frac {a _ {n}}{a _ {n}} = 1.$

而 $\lim\limits_{n\to \infty}\frac{n - 1}{n} = 1$ ，由夹逼准则，得

$\lim\limits_ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {a _ {n}}{a _ {n - 1}} = 1.$

题目内容:
(I) 求积分 $I_{n} = \int \frac{1}{(x^{2} + a^{2})^{n}}\mathrm{d}x(n\geqslant 1,a > 0)$ 的递推关系；

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: 证明: $f(x) = \int_{0}^{x} (t - t^2) \sin^{2n} t dt (x > 0)$ 的最大值为 $f(1)$ ，且 $f(1) \leqslant \frac{1}{(2n + 2)(2n + 3)}$ .
解析:
证 由 $f'(x) = (x - x^{2})\sin^{2n}x = 0$ ，得驻点 $x_{1} = 1, x_{2} = k\pi (k = 1, 2, \cdots)$ .

在 $x = k\pi$ 两侧， $f'(x) > 0$ ，可知 $x = k\pi$ 不是极值点；

在 x=1 两侧， $f'(x)$ 由正变负，故 x=1 是唯一极大值点，从而有 $f(x)$ 在 $(0,1]$ 上单调增加，在 $[1,+\infty)$ 上单调减少，即在 x=1 处取得最大值，即 $f(1)=\int_{0}^{1}(t-t^{2})\sin^{2n}t\,\mathrm{d}t$ 是 $f(x)$ 在 $(0,+\infty)$ 内的最大值。又

$f (1) = \int_ {0} ^ {1} (t - t ^ {2}) \sin^ {2 n} t \mathrm{d} t \leqslant \int_ {0} ^ {1} (t - t ^ {2}) t ^ {2 n} \mathrm{d} t = \frac {1}{2 n + 2} - \frac {1}{2 n + 3} = \frac {1}{(2 n + 2) (2 n + 3)},$

即 $f(1) \leqslant \frac{1}{(2n + 2)(2n + 3)}$ ，故不等式成立.

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容:
设 $f(x)$ 在 $[a, b]$ 上有二阶连续导数，且 $f(b) = f'(b) = 0$ ，证明：
$$\int_ {a} ^ {b} f (x) \mathrm{d} x = \frac {1}{2} \int_ {a} ^ {b} f ^ {\prime \prime} (x) (x - a) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x.$$
解析:
证 因为

$\begin{array}{r l} & {\int_ {a} ^ {b} f ^ {\prime \prime} (x) (x - a) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x} \\ & {= \int_ {a} ^ {b} (x - a) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} [ f ^ {\prime} (x) ] = (x - a) ^ {2} f ^ {\prime} (x) \Big | _ {a} ^ {b} - \int_ {a} ^ {b} 2 (x - a) f ^ {\prime} (x) \mathrm{d} x} \\ & {= - 2 \int_ {a} ^ {b} (x - a) \mathrm{d} [ f (x) ] = - 2 \left[ (x - a) f (x) \Big | _ {a} ^ {b} - \int_ {a} ^ {b} f (x) \mathrm{d} x \right] = 2 \int_ {a} ^ {b} f (x) \mathrm{d} x,} \end{array}$

所以 $\int_{a}^{b}f(x)\mathrm{d}x = \frac{1}{2}\int_{a}^{b}f''(x)(x - a)^{2}\mathrm{d}x$ ，得证.

【注】此题也可以按如下证明：

$\begin{array}{r l} \int_ {a} ^ {b} f (x) \mathrm{d} x & = \int_ {a} ^ {b} f (x) \mathrm{d} (x - a) = (x - a) f (x) \Big | _ {a} ^ {b} - \int_ {a} ^ {b} (x - a) f ^ {\prime} (x) \mathrm{d} x \\ & = - \int_ {a} ^ {b} (x - a) f ^ {\prime} (x) \mathrm{d} x = - \frac {1}{2} \int_ {a} ^ {b} f ^ {\prime} (x) \mathrm{d} [ (x - a) ^ {2} ] \\ & = - \frac {1}{2} \left[ (x - a) ^ {2} f ^ {\prime} (x) \Big | _ {a} ^ {b} - \int_ {a} ^ {b} (x - a) ^ {2} f ^ {\prime \prime} (x) \mathrm{d} x \right] = \frac {1}{2} \int_ {a} ^ {b} (x - a) ^ {2} f ^ {\prime \prime} (x) \mathrm{d} x. \end{array}$

这里将 $\int_{a}^{b}f(x)\mathrm{d}x$ 写为 $\int_{a}^{b}f(x)\mathrm{d}(x - a)$ 的技巧值得注意.又如：

设 $f(x)$ 在 $[0,1]$ 上有连续导数，且 $f(0)=f(1)=0$ ，证明：

$\left| \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (x) \mathrm{d} x \right| \leqslant \frac {M}{4}, \quad M = \max _ {0 \leqslant x \leqslant 1} \{| f ^ {\prime} (x) | \}.$

【证】

$\begin{array}{r l} \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (x) \mathrm{d} x & = \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (x) \mathrm{d} \left(x - \frac {1}{2}\right) = f (x) \left(x - \frac {1}{2}\right) \Big | _ {0} ^ {1} - \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left(x - \frac {1}{2}\right) f ^ {\prime} (x) \mathrm{d} x \\ & = 0 - \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left(x - \frac {1}{2}\right) f ^ {\prime} (x) \mathrm{d} x, \end{array}$

故

证令 $F(x) = \int_{a}^{x} f(t) \, \mathrm{d}t$ ，则 $F(a) = 0, F(b) = 0$ . 又

$\begin{array}{r l} \int_ {a} ^ {b} x f (x) \mathrm{d} x & = \int_ {a} ^ {b} x \mathrm{d} [ F (x) ] = x F (x) \Big | _ {a} ^ {b} - \int_ {a} ^ {b} F (x) \mathrm{d} x \\ & = - \int_ {a} ^ {b} F (x) \mathrm{d} x = 0, \end{array}$

由推广的积分中值定理，得 $-\int_{a}^{b} F(x) \, \mathrm{d}x = -F(\xi)(b - a) = 0 (a < \xi < b)$ ，故 $F(\xi) = 0$

$F(x)$ 在 $[a,\xi],[\xi,b]$ 上应用罗尔定理，有

$F^{\prime}(\xi_{1}) = 0,\quad F^{\prime}(\xi_{2}) = 0\quad (a < \xi_{1} < \xi ,\xi < \xi_{2} < b),$ 即 $f(\xi_1) = 0,f(\xi_2) = 0$ ，得证.

【注】此题也可采用反证法：

由已知条件存在 $\xi_1\in (a,b)$ ，使得 $f(\xi_1) = 0$ ，否则对 $\forall x\in (a,b),f(x)\neq 0$ ，则 $f(x)$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上恒正或恒负，与 $\int_{a}^{b}f(x)\mathrm{d}x = 0$ 矛盾.

又存在 $\xi_{2} \in (a, b), \xi_{2} \neq \xi_{1}$ , 使得 $f(\xi_{2}) = 0$ , 否则 $(x - \xi_{1})f(x)$ 在 $[a, \xi_{1}]$ 和 $[\xi_{1}, b]$ 上恒正或恒负, 则 $\int_{a}^{b}(x - \xi_{1})f(x)\mathrm{d}x \neq 0$ 与 $\int_{a}^{b}xf(x)\mathrm{d}x - \xi_{1}\int_{a}^{b}f(x)\mathrm{d}x = 0$ 矛盾, 故存在不同的 $\xi_{1}, \xi_{2} \in (a, b)$ , 使得 $f(\xi_{1}) = f(\xi_{2}) = 0$ .

章节: 第三章 一元函数积分学
题目内容: 设 $f(x)=x^{n}\sqrt{1-x^{2}}\left(x\in[0,1]\right)$ 与 $y=0$ 所围平面区域的面积为 $S_{n}, g(x)=\sin^{\frac{n}{2}}x\left(x\in\left[0,\frac{\pi}{2}\right]\right)$ 与 $y=0$ 所围平面区域绕 $x$ 轴旋转一周所得的体积为 $V_{n}(n=1,2,\cdots)$ ，求极限 $\lim\limits_{n\to\infty}\frac{\pi S_{n}}{V_{n}}$ .
解析:
解 由已知, $V_{n}=\pi\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\left(\sin^{\frac{n}{2}}x\right)^{2}\mathrm{d}x=\pi\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\sin^{n}x\mathrm{d}x$ ,

$\begin{array}{r l} \pi S _ {n} & = \pi \int_ {0} ^ {1} x ^ {n} \sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x \xlongequal {x = \sin t} \pi \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sin^ {n} t \cdot \cos^ {2} t \mathrm{d} t \\ & = \pi \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sin^ {n} t \mathrm{d} t - \pi \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sin^ {n + 2} t \mathrm{d} t = V _ {n} - V _ {n + 2}. \end{array}$

而

$\begin{array}{r l} V _ {n + 2} & = \pi \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sin^ {n + 2} t \mathrm{d} t = - \pi \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sin^ {n + 1} t \mathrm{d} (\cos t) \\ & = - \pi \left[ \cos t \cdot \sin^ {n + 1} t \Big | _ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} - \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \cos t \cdot (n + 1) \sin^ {n} t \cdot \cos t \mathrm{d} t \right] \\ & = \pi (n + 1) \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sin^ {n} t \cdot (1 - \sin^ {2} t) \mathrm{d} t = (n + 1) V _ {n} - (n + 1) V _ {n + 2}, \end{array}$

整理得 $V_{n+2} = \frac{n+1}{n+2} V_{n}$ ，所以

$\pi S _ {n} = V _ {n} - V _ {n + 2} = V _ {n} - \frac {n + 1}{n + 2} V _ {n} = \frac {1}{n + 2} V _ {n},$

故 $\lim\limits_{n\to \infty}\frac{\pi S_n}{V_n} = \lim\limits_{n\to \infty}\frac{1}{n + 2} = 0.$

(Ⅱ) 先证明 $x_{n} \in (0,1)$ .

当 $n = 1$ 时，由（I）知

$0 \leqslant x _ {0} \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (t) \mathrm{d} t < x _ {1} = \int_ {0} ^ {x _ {0}} f (t) \mathrm{d} t < x _ {0} f (0) \leqslant x _ {0} < 1.$
